gleng gzhi/bod yul kha ba'i ljongs 'dir gna' bo'i nurme nas glu gzhas dang /bro gar/ rol dbyangs/ lha mo sogs thun min sgyu rtsal gyis mngon par phyug pa'i rig rtsal rnam grangs phun sum tshogs pa dar khyab rgya cher yod pas mi rnams kyis glu gar gyi rgya mtsho zhes snyan pa'i che brjod mgrin pa'i dbyangs su gyer nas bstod par byed/dpe deb 'di'i rtsom pa po bod ljongs slob chen gyi dge rgan che mo sku gzhon gyi mtshan 'dzin pa zhol khang bsod nams dar rgyas lags ni bod kyi rgyun srol rig rtsal thad rnam dpyod mkhyen pa rgyas pa zhig yin pa dang krung go'i rol mo'i mthun tshogs kyi las 'dzin pa dang / rgyal yongs grangs nyung mi rigs rol mo'i mthun tshogs kyi las 'dzin/ krung go'i bod rol mo'i mthun tshogs kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa bcas kyi mtshan gnas yod pa'i mkhas dbang zhig yin/khong dgung lo chung ngu'i dus su gzhas sa shin tu dar ba'i lho kha

'phyongs rgyas su bzhugs pa dang / khyim rgyud sku mched rnams kyang glu gzhas dang rol dbyangs la dang zhen che ba sogs kyi bag chags bzang po rgyud la 'jags shing / mi rigs rig rtsal la brtse zhen ha cang che bas dgung lo bdun brgyad tsam nas gzhas chen dang / ldem glu/ ljags rkyang / rbad/ sgor gzhas/ shags sogs gna' rabs kyi glu gzhas mang po gtong mkhyen pa dang / de rjes lha sar phebs nas slob grwa 'grims zhor du nang ma stod gzhas dang / lha mo'i rnam thar / de bzhin sgra snyan sogs kyi rol cha slob sbyong gnang nas zlos gar gyi rig gnas thad sbyangs pa mi dman pa'i rmang gzhi bzang po yod pa zhig chags/ slob grwa thon rjes dgung lo bcu drug lor sngon ma'i sa gnas srid gzhung gi rtsis khang (mtho rim slob grwa )du zhugs pa dang chabs cig nang ma'i skyid sdug zer ba dmangs khrod kyi sgyu rtsal tshogs pa zhig yod pa de'i nang zhugs te skabs der grags pa che ba'i sgyu rtsal mkhas can rnam rgyal sogs dge rgan du bsten nas rgyun srol gyi rig rtsal spyi dang / khyad par du nang ma stod gzhas/ zhabs bro/ sgra snyan/ yang ching / tha'i hu'u/cing hu'u sogs rol cha sna tshogs slob sbyong dang nyams len dbyis phyin pa gnang bas mi ring bar rig rtsal la mkhas pa'i grags can mi sna'i gnas su 'khod/bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol btang rjes 1951lor gsar brjer

zhugs te gtso bo mi rigs rig rtsal gyi las gnasathog tu phyag las gnang ba dang / 1978lo nas bzung bod ljongs slob chen sgyu rtsal tshan pa'i rol mo'i dge rgan gyi mtshan gnas bzung ste bod kyi rgyun srol rig rtsal gyi slob rgyun spel ba'i las 'gan bzhes/ de'i ring khong gis slob 'khrid kyi lag len dang phun sum tshogs pa'i rig rtsal shes rtogs kyi nyams myong la brten nas bcu phrag rig pa'i nang tshan zlos gar dang 'brel ba'i lha mo dang / bro gar/ rol dbyangs/ nang ma stod gzhas sogs dar 'phel byung rim dang sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos/ sngon byon dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal mkhas can gyi lo rgyus dang mdzad rjes/ glu gzhas sgra sbyong skor gyi dbyangs kyi rnam gzhag sogs de sngon yig lam du stong char lus pa'i bod kyi rgyun srol rig rtsal skor gyi gnad don mang por rig lam gyi gzhung dang dngos byung gi lo rgyus zung sgril gyi sgo nas zhib 'jug zab par gnang zhing / gal che'i dpyad rtsom rim pa spel yod pa de rnams la gzengs bstod kyi bya dga' yang mang du thob yod pa red/ da res dpe skrun byas pa'i deb 'di ni khong gis slob 'khrid kyi phyag las gnang ba'i rgyud rim nang snga rjes su spel ba'i dpyad rtsom rnams phyogs bsdus byas pa zhig yin/deb 'di'i nang khong gis sku tshe hril por zlos gar rig rtsal la sbyangs pa dang nyams len gnang ba'i myong tshor dang nyams myong gi snying po rnams gsal bar mtshon pas rang re'i gangs can yul 'di'i rgyun srol rig

rtsal lo rgyus kyi 'phel rim la zhib 'jug dang de dag 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi thog nas mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba bya rgyur shin tsamakho ba'i dpyad gzhi'i rin thang ches cher ldan pa ma zad/ glu gar gyi rgya mtsho zhes pa'i snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs nam yang sgrog par byed pa'i dge mtshan du smin pa'i rgyur 'dren 'os pa bcas deb 'di'i nang don dang / don snying sogs mdor bsdus kyi lam nas sngon 'gro'i zhu mchid kyi tshul du bris pa'o sgong)pag she4shā ༷ zhe

dkarachaganang ma'i skyid sdug byung 'phel gyi lo rgyus zhib par gleng ba/ (1)bod kyi dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal mkhas can dge rgan rnam rgyal gyi lo rgyus/ (32)bod ljongs kyi rgyun srol a lce lha mo khag gi khyad par dang 'phyongs rgyas kha bro spun bdun bkra shis zhol pa lha mo'i 'byung khungs skor bshad pa/ (60)gangs khrod sa mtho'i mi rigs rol cha rgod po ste sgra snyan la rags tsam dpyad pa/ (101)rgyun srol a lce lha mo'i rnam thar gyi sgyu rtsal la rags tsam dpyad pa (114)bod kyi glu gzhas sgra sbyong skor gyi dbyangs kyi rnam gzhag rags tsam brjod pa/ (130)nang ma'i gzhas kyi skor/ (144)

stod gzhas dang nang ma'i gzhas kyi 'byung ba mdo tsam brjod pa (159)glu gar gyi rgya mtsho/ (183)kho bo dang kho bo'i sgyu rtsal 'gro lam/ (207)nang ma'i gzhas 〈ab car ma/〉 (216)lha mo'i gzhung brgyad kyi khungs bstan pa/ (225)

sna da4 sna 82zheshusmodatsho/〉༅depho(ngabidhe sogs kyi shis brjod dang 'brel ba'i gna' bo'i lugs bzang ya rabs kyi srol gtod ched rang ljongs kyi rig rtsal khag la bcos sgrig sogs mdzad pa dang /zhus bcu'i mdo 'grel 〉las zu snyan ngag dang / gar stabs dang / gtam rgyud dang rol mo rnams ni yid ma bde ba'i gnyen po'o/ /’ zhes byung ba ltar/ don dang ldan pa'i skul ma dang bcas glu gar gyi rtsa tshig dus da lta'ang 'dren byed kyi yul du mjal rgyu yod pa ni rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i rnam byung 'byung ba gsum ldan lo 'bras ldan gyi dus khrums zla ba phyi ma'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa dang po drang srong zla skyes lha mtshams kyi dga' mgur spyod pa'i 'chi med grub pa'i sbyor ba'i nyin mdzad pa ste/ spyi lo 1688lor babs shing / skabs der gzhung gi mdzad sgo khag dang dus mchod khag la gar pa zhes glu gar tshogs pa de dang 'bras gling mchod sprin gar pa (lha sa shar phyogs sku 'bum thang du yod )de gnyis so sor rtsa tshig dang 'brel ba'i lag deb yod pa dang /dmas khrod du 6 nang ma'i skyid sdug ’ ces pa'ang sgrig 'dzugs kyi byed sgo dang sbrags sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho nas kyang dmar dam gling gsum sgor mo dbyibs ( )'di 'dra 'khod pa'i lag deb cig kyang bstsal ba ltar lo gsar slebs nyer bka' shag srid gzhung gi bka' mgron brgyud lag deb gzhir bzung 'dzin bsgyur zhus te/ rtse shod phyag mdzod las khungs so so nas sngar lam ja mar dang gnang cha phran bu re gnang gi —— shākyi —— d+ngha

rdawer444༄ste/wāṣ+ṭhamo 46gle 4 tshogiyizhuyod/ de bzhin nang ma'i skyid sdug nang gi bgres gras tshos kyang 6 nga tshos skyid sdug tshogs pa 'di bzhin gong sa lnga pa chen po'i dus nas bzung da phan lo ngo sum brgya yas mas shig rgyun 'dzin byas pa red/mi ces gsungs kyi yod pa ji bzhin 66nang ma'i skyid sdug mi ces pa'i tha snyad de lnga pa chen po'i dus nas yod pa ni de snga spyi tshogs rnying pa'i nang bka' shag srid gzhung gi bka' mgron gnang myong ba'i bgres gras kha shas kyis kyang mkhyen gsal yin par ma zad/ rang nyid kyang bka' mgron byed myong la/lhag par lo na chung dus lo ngo bzhi tsam ring 6 nang ma'i skyid sdug ri der zhugs nas dmangs gzhas dang rol cha khag slob sbyong byed myong bas de ltar gsal shes yod/ de yang nang ma'i skyid sdug de tā la'i bla ma'i mdzad sgo khag la thad kur 'brel ba med kyang / bka' shag gi mdzad sgo kha shas dang / mang tshogs kyi dus mchod dang / spro skyid/ bag ston sogs kyi byed sgo khag la zhugs kyi yod/ der brten rang nyid 'tsho ba ngo ma brgyud myong ba zhig yin stabs rgyun srol de'i lo 'khor byed sgo'i skor rgyus babs kyis zhu rgyu gsham gsal/— 3 —

/da4la 82zhestugatshi/〉grob/lhun dngapo/nabama'i skyibasdugadesamadzatshog khrobadu byedasgospelatshugathogamar bodakyi logasar maranatsamasaskyidasdugatshogasporags sne dang / skyadagakhagatshong rigs khagabacasanasadagorgan rnamargyal rologasar ska ba zhesa'abrasagro zhib dang bya 'brag zasasder kha 'osa'atshamaspor sgrodapa dang / dgophugatshosakyang logasar skyamalazhes gong bzhin 'bulasrolayod/ skabasader rolartsed ladaga' ba'i khyim tshang tshosanang ma'i skyidasdugagadan zhu byasan gorimabazhin 'gro ba dang /rgyun dumidragadang tshong rigag mang tshogasakhrod kyi chang spodang /dbyar kha'i dusasagling gagatong ba/ de bzhin khyim tshang sosor bkra shisapa'i don chen gang zhig byung na yang nang ma'i skyid sdugagadan zhu byed srolayod/ de yang gdan zhu gnang brda 'am/ yang na bzhed brda wosogasapa gtong ba lasaskabasa'aphralaskad btang na mi khom pa mazad/mthong chung ltabur mngon nasami 'osapa byed/ de bzhin thugs spro khag gyigrolaston nyin dgong mo'i gsolatshigasatshar 'phralagasolargyab ces mchod chang dngulagyi khrung phor re btegasazin rjes/ sbyin bdaganas rolamo mkhan tshor khayig yig chen legasaskyesadangulasrang /༅༅zhes — —4—

baṃsgor444༄ste/riṣ+ṭhamo 4༄na ji tshordoyigazad/ rgyal mkhar chos rdzong pa'i nor bzang gzhung nang gi rnam thar phal cher la tshig rkang mang po yod/ de ni dbus gtsang bar gyi khyad par chen po zhig yin/ rgyal mkhar chos rdzong pa'i rnam thar gtong srol de sgyu rtsal ngos nas bshad na mgrin khug mang la snyan 'jebs 'gran zla dang bral ba'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin/ de bzhin rnam thar gyi skad sbyong byed srol thad nas bshad na'ang nga ro'i rtsa ba gsum dang / dbyangs kyi rnam gzhag lnga/sgra'i skyeganas brgyad sogs tshan rig dang mthun pa'i rgyu mtshan mang po yod kyang yig rdzob kyi rgyur bsams nas 'dir ma bris/gsum pa/ skyor lung a lce lha mo tshogs pa/de snga skyor lung rang du lha mo tshogs pa zhes yod skad tsam las gsal po zhig rang med khar mang che bas skyor lung lha mo tshogs pa a lce dwangs bzang gis gsar gtod byas tshul du brjod/ gang ltar a lce dwangs bzang dang rjes sor gyi lha mo'i dge rgan pad+ma bstan 'dzin khong gnyis ka skyor mo lung nas yin pa dang / a lce dwangs bzang ni bud med gzhan dang mi 'dra bar kha spu yang phran bu yod la/ rnam thar dang 'khrab rtsal mchog tu mkhas pa yin pa tsam du ma zad/ khong gis 'khrab gzhung so so'i nang la rnam thar gyi gdangs kyang gsar bzo mang po byas pa ni gu ——tan1 ——

44dujilha'e/48tshonasno la4〉〈07sgo7〉〉gi4na༄ phogazhas ma rnam thar dang 〉glu sogs red zer srol 'dug sa lce dwangs bzang dge rgan byed ring byings la tsha gcun ran pas tshang mas brtsi bkur chen po byed pa red/ lha sa'i zho ston zin 'phral la a lce lha mo sko gzhan rnams sa gnas so sor log 'gro ba dang / skyor mo lung lha mo bar sa gnas su dmigs bsal sa rten sogs med stabs zho ston zin 'phral sa gnas gang sar 'khrab ston byed par 'gro ba dang skabs re rgya gar khul du'ang 'gro ba yin/ a lce dwangs bzang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i shes bya dang glu gar 'khrab rtsal la byang chub pa zhig song ba las mkha' 'gro ma red zer ba dang / yang 'ga' zhig gis a lce dwangs bzang mkha' 'gro yin dogs med/ /mkha' 'gro yin na rgyal khams skor dogs med// ces shod srol yang byung / nor gling zho ston skabs sdings cha'i thog bud med 'khrab 'don mi chog stabs skyor lung 'khrab ston nyin a lce dwangs bzang sdings cha'i 'og tu dmigs bsal gdan thog ṭu bsdad nas zhib rtogs kyis de nub phyir log rjes de nyin gyi 'khrab ston mi sna so sor legs nyes la bsngags brjod dam skyon brjod byed kyi yod pa red/ a lce dwangs bzang la kha spu phran bu yod pa ltar pho bzo dod pas 'khrab gzhung khag gi nang ka la dbang po dang tshong dpon nor bzang sogs pho 'khrab kho na 'khrab ston byed pas brjid nyams dod la skad shugs chen po yod tshul bshad rgyun 'dug skabs de nas dus da lta —72—

naistusta444༄ste/riṣ+ṭhamo ne 4༄gradzojichodiyi0bar la yang mi tsho'i kha rgyun snyan grags ches cher khyab dīrte naskyor lung dge rgan mig dmar rgyal mtshan zer ba zhig byung ba ni bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i chu lug spyi lo 1893lor rin spungs rdzong khongs rong byams chen gyi khongs su 'khrungs/ khong chung byis pa'i dus nas skad thugs che la gdangs dang 'gyur khug phun sum tshogs pa lhan skyes rang gshis su grub pa lta bur snang / skabs der mi tshang mas phru gu skad thugs che la snyan 'jebs ldan pa zhig 'dug ces bsngags brjod byed pa de a lce dwangs bzang dang pad ma bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis thos rjes pha mas kyang mos mthun byung ba ltar thabs brgya jus stong gis skyor lung a lce lha mo tshogs khongs su khrid/ a lce dwangs bzang gi dus la skyor lung lha mo yar rgyas 'gro bzhin pa'i thog yang rtse'i sgang la yas sgron gyi dpe ltar mig dmar rgyal mtshan slebs rjes de bas yar rgyas gong 'phel du phyin/ des na nor gling zho ston skabs skyor mo lung 'khrab ston nyin ltad mo lta mkhan mi tshogs mang bas bsdad sa'i thog spa se 'tshong srol med stabs bsdad sar hab thob brgyab nas zing zing longs longs kyis 'khrug rtsod byed pa dang rtsi shing me tog sogs gcag gcog kyis gra ma 'grigs pa mang po yong /tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum pa chen po gzhi rkang rnam thar la mnyes po yod kyang / gong gsal gnas tshul de 'dra yong dus sun snang lta bus ma mnyes pa'i tshul gyis skyor lung lha mo tshogs pa gnas skabs shig ring nor ji ——dwam(5—— d+ngha

naideng444༄༄ciriṣ+ṭhamogu'i༅namadzoji rayi0 ne gzhung dang rnam thar rgyugs bzhes gnang gi yod pashāri/ —sderdo'i ring rgyugs — bzhes gnang yul spro khang nang du phyi mi gcig kyang gtong mi chog kyang /skyor lung lha mo'i rgyugs bzhes nyin ngo shes brgyud de mi re gnyis nang du tshud kyang / khong gnyis de nyin nang du 'gro ma thub par sgo rgyab sgo 'gram —4 nas rnam thar nyan nas sdod dgos byung ba dang / mig dmar rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar btang ba khong gnyis pos go dus rtse drung thub bstan kun dga' rang dbang med par mig chu shor ba red ces khong rang nyid yod sar dgod bro bro byas nas gsung gi 'dug da dung de nyin lha mo ba mi re gnyis byas te rnam thar rgyugs len sa spro khang yangs steng thog khang pa ka gcig ma sge'u khung khra ma bod shog btang ba zhig yod pas/ de'i nang mig dmar rgyal mtshan gyis rnam thar gtong skabs skad kyi rang thugs che bas phra ma'i shog bu ral ba red ces grags/ gang ltar dge rgan mig dmar rgyal mtshan ni gtso bo rnam thar tsam ma zad/ zhar byung glu gzhas 'khrab gtong sogs la sbyangs te glu dbyangs kyi rigs dang gar gyi rnam 'gyur sna tshogs la byang chub par gyur stabs/ lha sa'i dmangs khrod du skospro glu gar la dga' ba rnams kyis khong nas slob sbyong zhus te dmangs khrod du skabs der rnam thar dar srol chen po byung bar grags/ rjes su dge rgan mig dmar rgyal mtshan lho kha rtsed thang du bza' zla bu phug dang bcas pa gzhis chags pa red/ gong zhus bzhin skyor lung lha mo tshogs pa rgyun — sbu ——rwamashu)—— 2ston

da4snarngu'ir+sha4)/4nya༄sno la4sgos47sgomangage ga4dang du sa gnas gang sar 'khrab ston du bskyod nas kong por phyin pa dang /d+ku skabs der kong yul der zas dug ster ba'i dar srol ngan pa zhig chags yod pas dge rgan de nyid la dug phog nas nad kyis mnar bzhin phyir log lam bar 'bri gung 'pho ba chen mo mjal te lha sar slebs nyer dga' ldan la zhol gtsang thog tu sku gshegs pa red/ skabs der khong bgrang bya lnga bcu yas mas yin tshod/ shod srol ltar na kho pa tsho nang khul nas ma rungs khog bcug phrag dog zhe sdang gis rgyud brlams pa'i mi ngan gyis zas dug sbyar nas bkrongs pa red zer srol 'dugaskyoganas de ltar thos skabs mi tshang ma blo pham yid chad kyis phyosnang dang / phangs sems chen po byed pa dang /mig dmar rgyal mtshan dang 'dra ba'i glu gar rol rtsed la mkhas pa'i mi de 'dra zhig sngon chad byung myong med la phyis kyang 'byung mi srid ces gcig grags kyis khas len byed/dge rgan mig dmar rgyal mtshan gyi gnas tshul zhib par mkhyen 'dod na/ nges pa don gyi mkhas pa chen po hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar gyi gsung rtsom phyogs bsgrigs krung go bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang nas par 'grems byas pa der gzigs/ dam pa de nyid kyis mig dmar rgyal mtshan la mtshan bstod 'di 'dra zhig gnang ba ni mig dmar rgyal mtshan skad gsang mtho zhing snyan//mig dang rna ba'i rgyan gyi mchog gyur pa//mig las gces par kun gyi dga' zhen byed//mig mi 'dzum gyi —76—

rdadeng444zhanarinyal༄ ༄rna'id/rayi0 gar mkhan skyedas par byas//zhes kyang 'khod 'dugab sta lce lha mor 'khrab gzhung che khag brgyad yod pa las/ tshogs pa khag so so'i sbyangs stobs sam/ lag rgyun nam/ nyams myong la gzhigs pas skyor lung lha mo bas pad+ma 'od 'bar dang 'gro ba bzang mo gzugs kyi nyi ma de gsum gzhung dag shos dang 'brab rtsal mkhas po yod pas 'khrab ston byed pa dang / bar la tshig grogs dang dbyangs sbyor ra gsum tsam las tshigs bcad kho na gtong ba red/tshig rkang bzhi re byas pa nyung shas yin/ yin na'ang de snga skyor lung lha mos rnam thar 'gyur khug gtong stangs kyi thad la do snang chen po byed kyi yod pa de ni rnam thar snyan dang mi snyan gyi sgyu rtsal gal che shos shig yin pas de la mgrin khug kyang zer/ ji tsam khug mang ba de tsam gyis legs par brtsi ba yin pas/ khug bcu grangs kyang rgyag srol yod/ de bzhin 'khrab rtsal thad la skyor lung lha mo ba 'khrug cha dod po yod/ gzhi rkang lha mo tshang mar dal rdung dang mgyogs rdung zer ba sogs yod kyang / skyor lung lha mo bar mi sna'i byed las rkang lag stangs stabs dang bstun nas chings kyi rnam grangs mang la 'khrug po yod pa de la mi tshos dga' po byed/ —77—

na 44/jilha4)/4nyamalasno la4〉ḍi7duspra phanor/4 bzhi pa/ rgyal mkhar chos rdzong a lce lha mo/rgyal mkhar chos rdzong gi a lce lha mo tshogs pas 'khrab gzhung brgyad las gong gsal gsum phud gtso bo 〈rnar bzang nyidang / 〈rgya bza' bal bza' 〉 〈snang sa 'od 'bum 〉yag shos 'khrab ston byed pa yin/ lhag par du nor bzang gi gzhung de kho pa tshor thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos shig yod pa ste/ chas zhugs mi sna gtso che ba yab rgyal po dang yum chen a ma rgyal sras/ yid 'phrog lha mo/ de min gyi mi sna so so'i rang gshis mtshon thub pa'i nang don de dag la gzhigs pa'i 'khrab rtsal dang rnam 'gyur ston thub pa zhig yod pa'i thog la gzhung don dang mi 'gal ba'i thog nas gtsang phyogs yul don dang mi 'gal ba'i thog nas gtsang phyogs yul skad thog la lhug tshig tu bsgyur nas rnam thar gtong ba zhig yin/ de yang skad gshis kyi thog nas bshad na/ sa paṇa kyi 〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉las 6 pho sgra ngar la brjid pa dang / /mo sgra phra zhing 'dar ba dgos/ /ma ning sgra ni sgyur cing mnyen/ /mi zhes gsungs pa ltar pho mo'i skad gshis dbye ba chod bde yang rnam thar gyi gdangs gshis kyi thog nas kyang pho mo'i gdangs gshis mngon gsal dod pos dbye thub pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos mngon gsal dod po de ni rwa ——dwam/)—— d+ngha

rgyal mkhar chos rdzong a lce lha mo'i dmigs bsal gyi khyad chos 'gran zla bral ba zhig yin/ nga rang gi dran thog spyi lo 1930lo skor nang rgyal — mkhar rdzong a lce lha mo tshogs pa'i dge rgan dam chos zer ba zhig byung skesong bas khong rang nyid 'khrab rtsal dod la rnam thar gtong srol thad la — ljamachog tu mkhas pa dang / de bzhin lha mo tshogs pa'i khongasami byings kyi nang la'ang chas zhugs mi sna so so'i rnam thar dang 'khrab 'khyer la mchog tu mkhas pa'i mi sna 'dzoms po yod pas lo shas ring zho ston skabs lha sar skad grags chod pa byung ba dang / khong gi rjes la dge rgan chos rgyal zer ba khong ni rnam thar mkhas la 'khrab rtsal dod po zhig yod kyang / lha mo ba byings la slob khrid dang / shul 'dzin gso skyong bya rgyur 'thus shor chen po byung bas/ spyi lo 1940lo skor nas rgyal mkhar chos rdzong pa'i a lce lha mo ba glo bur je sdug tu phyin pa dang / dge rgan de yang zho ston lo gcig ring rngon pa dang por don mi chog pa'i bka' nyes kyang btang ba red/lnga pa/ gcung pa a lce lha mo/gcung pa a lce lha mo tshogs pa de ngam ring rdzong khongs yin pas/kho tsho'i shod srol ltar thang stong rgyal pos a lce lha mo bud med bdun nas rgya lu lon pa dang bcas pa cha tshang bar 'phel rgyas gtong sa de gcung ri gu ——rwaṇ+ḍisbyo/—— stab

//de/ ————na ripodzesari gormidzesabasgogo gu'i74༄mthob gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i sgra 3dang 4gnyis zung 'jug gi sgra gnyis bcas khyon dbye ba bzhir phye ba'i sgra bzhi de ltar yin pa dang / de bzhin 6 spyang kir grags pa mi zhes pa'i gcan gzan tha snyad cig yod pa de ni gong gsal gyi skad bzhi la zer ba dang / de'i rgyu mtshan ni bod rigs kyi dmangs gzhas las sgra phyed kyi gtong srol goms gshis de tsam rang med pa'am snyan po mi byed pa lta bu yin pa ste 71dang 34de gnyis ka sgra phyed yin pas nyan 'dod med pa ltar/ spyang ki ni mi rnams kyi blo la mi bab pa'i gcan gzan gdug rtsub can zhig yin stabs/ de'i skad kyang nyan 'dod med pa ji bzhin sgra de dag kyang spyang ki'i skad la sbyar ba red snyam pa 'dug de bzhin mtheb rgyag la ming tshig 'ga' yod pa mdzub mnan/ dkyil mdzub mnan/ ldem mnan/ mtheb tsagamatheb stong / yar thud/ mar shud (spyi ming 'dred thud )zer ba sogs yod pa ltar mtheb kyi rgyag stangs kyis sgra snyan gyi snyan cha'i sgyu rtsal la thugs rkyen chen po yod pa tsam ma zad/ yul phyogs so so'i mtheb srol 'dra min yod pa des yul phyogs so so'i khyad chos kyi bro ba'ang mi 'dra ba re thon yong gi yod/ mtheb rgyag sgyu rtsal de dag dbyangs gzugs kyi thog nas myo/tshon tshul gyi rtags tsam las zhib phra'i ngo sprod byed dka' tsam yod stabs/ dmar khrid lag len nas byang chub pa byed dgos/gsham du sgra snyan dang rol cha gzhan dag gi sgra gshis ngos nas —108—

be+ermekho444shesaḥshāg64ba 2 5 tshogiyi0ba tshebyung )de yang dmigs bsal gyi dbyangs gsum mtshams sbyor zhes 'bod/ de'i skyeganas mgrin pa dang / mchu gnyis yin/(5) u ri zhes bstod pa'i nga ro yin/ yun tshad gong bzhin thogaskyeganas mchu yin 6 su mi zhes sgra ring ba yin/ de gnyis 'don skabs ring thung gi khyad par thog lce rtsa cung btegs pa dang / mchu rub cing mi 'phrad par dbugs rang bzhin du glod pa bcas byed dgos/ gong gsal dbyangs kyi rnam gzhag de dag glu gzhas dngos su gtong ba'i skabs su gal gnad tsheb yin pa ni 'dren pa'i tshul du bshad ma dgos pa'i thog 'gyur gtong ba'i bar la dbyangs kyi bsgyur ba'i rang bzhin ni mi rigs kyi skad gshis kyi bro ba 'don thub pa'i nus pa de ja dang / tsha yi 'brel ba ltar yin/le tshan gsum pa/ sgra'i skyeganas brgyad ces pa de yin/ de'i gnas ni mgrin pa dang / sna dang / spyi bo dang/ rkan dang / lce dang / so dang / mchu dang / khog pa bcas yin/ de yang yig 'bru so sor gzhigs pas gnas dang byed pa/ rtsol ba bcas yod pa las/sgra'am/ skad zer ba'i rgyu'am/ 'byung khungs de/ dril bur dpe sbyar na/ dril bu'i khog pa ste/ 6 gnas mi yin pa dang / dril bu'i lce ste/66byed pa ’ yin zhing / skad sgrogs par byed pa'i 6 rtsol ba mi ni rlung ngam/yang na lag pas skul dgos pa de yin/ der brten rang res/ a/su ——13sbyo/—— —39

r+shasgor444༄te/sngaṣ+ṭhamo 2 hejichodiyi0'a ha a bcas yin/ skad sbyong skabs thog ma'i sgra gabyeṅge was mtshon par byas te/ kā/ kā/ kā zhes 'bod dgos pa yin/ de klog skabs lce'i rtsa bas mgrin pa bsnams nas dbugs lhod por glod de glo bur du thon pa'i sgra gdangs shig yin pa dang dbugs drag che ba sna nas 'don par byed do/ sna thugs che bas pho sgra yin/(2)rkan las skyes pa'i sgra sbyong / der yig 'bru bcu gnyis te/ ca cha ja nya/ tsa tsha dza zha/ ya sha/ tshe.obacas yin/ de dag las skad sbyong skabs gong bzhin sgra gcig gis mtshon par byas te/ chu/ chu/ chu zhes 'bod dgos/ sgra de klog skabs lce'i dbus de rkan la 'thab pa las sgra skyes nus pa dang / sgra thugs ran pas ma ning gi sgra yin/(3)lce rtsa dang / so las skyes pa'i sgra sbyong / der yig 'bru bdun te/ ta tha da na/ za la sa bcas yin/ de dag skad sbyong skabs sgra gcig gis mtshon par byas te/ dā/ tā/ dā zhes 'bod dgos/ de klog skabs yas sor lce rtse bkar nas sgra thon pa byed dgos/ sgra thugs zhan pas mo sgra yin/(4)lce mchu gnyis las skyes pa'i sgra sbyong / der yig 'bru bzhi ste/nga nya na ma bcas yin/ skad sbyong skabs sgra mjug shos des mtshon par byas te/ mā/ mā/ mā zhes 'bod dgos/ klog skabs skyeganas lce mchu tsam ma zad sna dang bcas pa yin/ sgra thugs zhan sa shin tu mo nga ——1pho/1—— sgo

rdar44ge'i5'ab /nyid༅༅/ / nang ma'i gzhas kyi skor/ /rang ljongs kyi slob grwa chen mo dbu brnyes nas da phan lo ngo drug lhag tsam song ring tang gi dbu khrid 'og ljongs yongs kyi rig gnas slob gso'i 'thab phyogs khag la legs skyes zam mi chad pa phul dang 'bul bzhin pa'i thog da lam slar yang rang slob nang khul du tshan rig slob gso'i mthun tshogs dbu brnyes pa ni yang rtse'i thog la yas sgron zer ba ltar yag thog yag brtsegs kyi bya ba bzang po zhig yin pas dgos nges shig dang / ha cang 'tshams pa bcas yin pas ngas go skabs 'di dang bstun nas bkra shis bde legs zhu bzhin du mchis/ slad kyang tshan rig slob gso mthun tshogs kyis ming don mtshungs pa'i sgo nas rgyun mthud dang / bar ma chad pa'i thog nas slob gso tshan rig gi las don yag po byas te rang ljongs kyi rig gnas slob gso'i 'thab phyogs kyi bya gzhag khag la sngar bas lhag pa'i grub 'bras 'thob rgyur yid ches yod/zhar du rang nyid kyi ched las dang bcas 'gan bab kyi rig rtsal rā ——1tho po/—— 4

naicer454༄ste/gaṣ+ṭhamo 46gle 4chodoyizhudamangs gzhas nang ma'i skor nas cung zad zhu bar 'don pa ni/ spyir na rang ljongs 'di bzhin gdod ma'i mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra zhing lo rgyus yun ring yod pa tsam ma zad/ de dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i rig gnas kyang gzhan dang 'gran par nus pa'i rgya che la gting zab pa tsam yod/ lhag par du rig rtsal skor la mi rigs kyi khyad chos mngon par gsal ba'i rig rtsal gyi rnam grangs brjod kyis mi langs ba zhig yod pa'i nang nas dmangs gzhas nang ma zhes pa de sgyu rtsal gyi rang bzhin dang /rta dbyangs kyi sgra tshad mtho la snyan 'jebs dod pa zhig yin pa dang / lo rgyus kyang yun ring tsam yod pa zhig yin/ da phan rig rtsal ched las mkhas pa re gnyis kyis brtag dpyad dang / ngo sprod byas yod kyang gnad la 'phigs pa zhig gang nas yong / de las ldog ste la la 'khyog bshad du mi 'gro ba'i nges pa'ang med/ mi rigs gang zhig yin rung rang nyid kyi pha mes rnams kyi yig tshang la dpyad gzhi byas te rgyud 'dzin gyi thog nas 'phel rgyas sam gsar gtod byed pa ni chos nyid lta bur gyur yod kyang /lo rgyus la 'khyog bshad bya rgyu der do snang chen pos yo bsrang ma byas tshe rjes 'dzin gyi skyebo rnams the tshom gyi gnas la gyar nas mgo bo rmongs su 'jug pa las 'os med/ der brten nang ma'i gzhas kyi 'byung khungs nas bshad na de'i tha snyad ni lo ngo stong phrag gong nas yod pa zhig red 'dug pa/ dper na/ dus rabs bdun pa tsam gyi nang slob dpon ji ——145—

8844ge'i5'ab /nyitsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i 〈gar thig bris dbyangs rnga yang rnga sbub gsil rnams kyi man ngag 〉ces pa'i nang tshan 6 dbyangs kyi bka' chab mi las oglur blangs/ bde legs kun 'dus kyi glu zhes sogs glu'i rnam grangs sum cu so lnga tsam 'khod pa'i nang nas bcu gcig pa zhang zhung mang nang ma'i gzhas mi zhes 'khod 'dug pa ma zad/ yi ge de dag bod gna'i 'bri srol te skung yig mang po zhig 'dug pas der gzhigs na nang ma'i gzhas de bod rigs kyi gna' bo'i dmangs gzhas shig rang yin pa las/ sus rtsom 'dis bzos zhes bshad na dmangs gzhas kyi khyad chos dang yang mi mthun pa dang nang don la dpyad na'ang lo yun ring tsam yin pa gsal shes thub snyam pa de ltar yang tā la'i bla ma lnga pa'i tshun nas dus skabs so sor spyi tshogs thog nas mi sna mi nyung ba zhig gis nang ma'i gzhas gsar rtsom mang po byas yod pa dang / lhag par rang ngos nas da phan dus deb khag la nang ma'i gzhas kyi skor la rtsom yig snga rjes spel yod na'ang nang ma'i gzhas ji tsam la dar khyab byung tshul nges shes med par 'ol tshod yin kyang bar skabs shig nas slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i dbyangs kyi bka' chab mi de mjal rjes nang ma'i gzhas 'di lo rgyus ring tsam yin pa nges shes rnyed pa byung /de yang nga rang lo na gzhon dus lha sa'i 6 nang ma'i skyid sdug mices pa der lo ngo bzhi tsam dmangs gzhas nang ma dang / stod gzhas/ de rwa ——17/(5—— d+ngha

naiwer44spyo༄ste/riṣ+ṭhamo 46gle gru tshogi/zhubazhin bod kyi rol cha khag la slob sbyong byas te sdod myong ba ltar/ da cha skabs de'i rgyun srol nang ma'i skyid sdug gi khongs mi nga rang the bas mi re gnyis tsam las lhag mi 'dug stabs de'i skor gyi lo rgyus kyi dpang mi yin snyam pa'i spobs pa nga la med kyang / rgyus bab zhu ba'i bab thob rang nyid la 'dug snyam pa ltar sngon la nang ma'i skyid sdug ngo sprod mdor bsdus tsam zhig zhus na phyis kyi rig rtsal ched las gzhon nu rnam par dpyad gzhi gnang rgyur dgos pa dang phan pa 'dug snyam pa yin/ de yang lo ngo sum brgya lhag tsam gyi gong rol na/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 〈mig yid rna ba'i bcud kyi dga' ston 'gugs pa'i lcags kyo 〉zhes par 6 mchod yon gong ma rnam gnyis nas bzung (tā la'i lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dang go sgribastan 'dzin chos rgyal gnyis la zhu )'dun sa chen po 'di nyid du'ang gnam lo gsar dus sogs dga' ston rngam chen gyi las kun /tazlos gar sogs gzhan rnams la la spom cha ches pas blochung rnams la spro ba mi rnyed pa dang / la la dag bzang rtsi med pa'i phal rtags kyi rnam pa 'di nyid dar rgyas su che zhing / zhes dang / skabs der glu gar la byang chub rigs tshang ma ched 'bod kyi stod khul gyi glu gar gsar pa mang dag cig 'dug rung / gtsang sde srid nas sgrig kha mdzad pa (bcos sgrig byas pa ) dang 'grig rigs rnams gar rol pa rnying pa ma shing nam mkha' dang glu gar la byang chub rigs tshang mar 'chems lus —147—

/ rdar༄445'bamor+shad kyi4 yod med dogs dpyad cing khu bsdus pa dang / rnying pa rdoms kyi rta la zhus dag dang / bar skabs ma 'grig pa dang ji nub tu song ba'i gdangs rnams gsar du gsos/ de phyin be ta'i glu la sogs gsar pa ji snyed rnams chu gnyer bzhin zad pa mi snang bas phyir dbyungs ba sogs gsal ba de la gzhigs na gtsang sde srid dang / tā la'i lnga pa chen po'i dus bod kyi glu gar la bcos sgrig rgya che snga rjes gnang ba gsal po red/de bzhin sde srid kyi gsung rtsom thor bu khag la gzhung gi mdzad sgo khag la mchod sprin gar pa dang / dmangs khrod du gna' bo'i bod rigs kyi glu gar sogs gtong srol rtsa 'dzugs kyi gar pa rang la rtsa tshig lag deb chen mo/ 'bras gling mchod sprin gar pa dang / dmangs khrod nang ma'i skyid sdug gnyis la sde srid kyi dmar dam gling gsum sgor mo 'khod pa'i lag deb bcas ni da lta lo na drug cu yas mas la phebs pa'i bgres gras rnams kyis mkhyen gsal dang / lhag par sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' mgron gnang myong mkhan bshad sgra dga' ldan dpal 'byor mchog (da lta ljongs srid gros rgyun ud )la'ang gsung rgyu 'dug pa ma zad/ skabs der bka' mgron gnang myong mkhan mang po yod khar nga rang yang bka' mgron byed myong ba yin na/ bka' mgron gyi lag deb de dag gzhir bzung bka' shag nas 'dzin bsgyur byas te rtse shod las khungs khag nas lo gsar mtshams ja mar sogs kyi dgos cha zhu srol yod pa dang / de su ——148——

nairbeto454༄ste/gaṣ+ṭhamo narnon 4chodiyi0ltar yin stabs nang ma'i skyid sdug de bzhin tā la'i lnga pa' dus nas yod pa zhig yin pa sde srid kyi lag deb kha byang du/ lha sa'i dmangs khrod glu gzhas rgya nang ma'i skyid sdug mi ces pa'i dmar dam sbyar ma de rang gis gsal shes thub pa yin/ nang ma'i skyid sdug gi bgres gras rnams kyi gsung rgyun la yang / nga tsho 8 nang ma'i skyid sdug ri 'di tā la'i lnga pa'i dus nas rgyun 'khyongs byas pa red/ ces dang lha sa'i rdzong rgyab klu khang 'di bzhin tā la'i drug pa'i dus la gsar bzhengs gnang ste char chu dus su 'bebs pa dang / lo chu rtag tu legs pa sogs kyi thugs smon mtshams sbyor gnang lugs gzhung yig khag la gsal ba dang 'brel/ de nas bzung ste bod zla 4tshes 15nyin bod srid gzhung rnying pa'i bka' shag 'khor bcas dang mang tshogs tshos gling skor dang 'brel ba'i klu khang mda' yab 'og canang ma'i skyid sdug gis nang ma'i gzhas dang / stod gzhas gtong srol sogs 'dzugs pa gnang ba dang / khong rang nyid kyang skabs re nang ma'i glu gzhas gsan par klu khang la phebs lugs sogs shod srol mang po yod pa tsam ma zad dus dkyil bar tā la'i bzhugs khri yod pa dang 'dzam gling thog snyan par grags pa'i tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i gsung mgur gyi nang don la dbyangs sbyor byas pa'i nang ma'i gzhas kyang mi nyung ba zhig yod/ de ltar yig cha khag dang / rgan rabs kyi gsung rgyun sogs las don dngos de 'dra zhig yin/ bar skabs 'ga' zhig canang ma'i —149—

rdar44ge'i5'ab /nyigazhas 'byung lugs kyi thad la bzhed pa mi mthun pa'i lta tshul gsar pa ste/nang ma'i gzhas kyi sgyu rtsal 'di ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i (1780—1804) rjes su gzhi nas byung ba dang / de yang spyi lo 1810g.yas g.yon du rdo ring gung bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor gyis brtsams pa'i 〈rdo ring paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam thar 〉las drangs 'dug kyang gung bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor gyis rnam thar nang rgya nag 'di klu'i rigs la song gshis 'byor pa tshezhing ltad mo'i rnam grangs mang ba/ lhag don rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs de kun gdangs 'gyur snyan zhing shin tungo mtshar che ba 'dug stabs/ de sngaphan bod du ma dar ba rgya'i rol dbyangs gras dbang po lag pa'i dbyibs can rgya skad du zhing zer ba dang /yang bangs khri 'dra bar rgya skad du yang chen zer ba de gnyis kyi skad gnas 'tshol lugs nas bzung gdangs 'gyur gyi bar slob sbyong byed dus yang chin gtong lugs ha lam shes nas zhing du 'bod pa de slob 'go tshugs tsam la khong 'brum pa na zhing / de mjug bod du phyir log byed ran gyis slob 'phror lus kyang / de dus bod du mnga' ris sgra snyan dang lhan cig rgya'i yang chin dang 'phred gling gnyis brtsams nas gtong srol thog ma'i lag 'khrid kyi rgyun 'dzugs byed po ni kho bo lags zhes gsal ba de tsam la rgyu mtshan du byas te nang ma'i gzhas rdo ring gung bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor rang nyid kyis brtsams pa red ces bshad na su — 150——

nairbeco454༄ste/riṣ+ṭhamo 43gle gru tshogisproṭade ni rtsa ba nas mi 'thad snyam/ gang lags she na/ ga ga nas nang ma'i gzhan bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor rang nyid kyis brtsams pa yin/ zhes rang rnam nang rtsa ba nas bris med pa dang / gnyis nas yab gung paṇ+ḍi ta dang / 'di'i sras pa sangs tshe ring khong rang nyid bcas kyi rnam thar zhib phra 'khod yod pa tsam ma zad/ lhag par khong rang nyid kyi sku tshe'i mdzad pa tshe'abring chung gsum rnam thar nang bris yod pa ltar/ gal te nang ma'i gzhas khong gis brtsams pa zhig yin na de ni mdzad rjes tshegs shig yin pas de bas ma bris pa ci la srid/ de bzhin nang ma'i gzhas 'di bzhin tā la'i lnga pa dang / drug pa sogs kyi skabs la yod yod pa zhig yin pa ni bshad ma dgos pa'i thog lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i nang ma'i gzhas mang po zhig yod pa'i nang nas 〈bkra la shis pa 〉zhes pa'i nang ma'i gzhas zhig yod pa de'i gzhas tshig dbyangs sbyor dang bcas pa gsham du ngo sprod zhu rgyu yin/de yang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos brtsams par mdzad pa'i 〈rab gsal gser gyi snye ma 〉las gong sa lnga pa chen po chu khyi lor sku mya ngan las 'das gdong gi bka' chems su dgos pa du ma'i slad du mya ngan 'das tshul yun ring gsang rgya dgos pa tshang ma'i dgongs mnga' bzhin 'dir zhib phra ma dgos pa byas/ drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho dgung grangs bcu gsum tsam la phebs skabs gzhi nas gsang rgya dkrol te/——151—— d+ngha

rnar44/choringab /nyi6 lnga pa drug par 'phos pa'i gtam rna ba'i bcud len 'bring bsdus mi sgrogs sbyangs gnang skor/ lha sar mi dpon/ (thokrang )zhang grong pa rdo rje dang / shar bkra shis gnyis kyis me tog ldum ra'i thang du (bar skor byang rgyud )khrom gzigs khang mdun dang snang rtse shag gi bar der zer/lha sa ba rnams la 8 rna bcud mi bklags par/ rgan pa khag gcig gis sna sku drin che/ lo de tsam gyi bar rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa ma bzhugs pa'i sa steng mi'i sdug bsngal dang / chos 'jig rten gyi thugs khur thams cad sde srid sku zhabs gcig pus bzhes/ nged tshos sa rub pa ma shes par nyi ma shar ba mthong byung sogs lab lab btang skad 'dug ces gsal ba ltar/ lha sa'i mang tshogs kyis sde srid la bka' drin rjes dran gyi sgo nas thugs rje che zhu mtshon par byas pa ltar/ skabs der lha sar dmangs gzhas kyi tshogs pa ste/ 6 lha sa'i nang ma'i skyid sdug mi nang gong gsal gyi nang don de la gzhigs pa'i nang ma'i gzhas 〈bkra la shis pa 〉zhes brtsams pa yin/ gzhas tshig nang don 66bkra shis ldum ra'i nang la/ / g.yang chags me tog 'khrungs bzhag / snga dro'i zil pa ma yal /nyin dgung sbrang char bab byung / /mi zhes dang / ( tshig grogs la bka' drin che yag ga la zer na yag byung )de dag gi go don ni tā la'i drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i yab rig 'dzin bkra shis bstan 'dzin zhu ba dang khong gi mtshan zur nas drangs te bkra shis ldum ra'i nang la g.yang su ——1shu)rwape—— shu

naicer444༄ste/gaṣ+ṭhamo 46gle ji tshogiyizhuchags me tog 'khrungs bzhag ces sku phreng drug pa bltams pa dang snga dro'i zil pa ma yal ces snga dro tā la'i lnga pa chen po sku zil pa khrum mer bzhugs yod snyam pa'i skabs der nyin dgung sbrang char bab pa ni drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho sku bltams pa'i dril bsgrags pas na/ nyin dgung sbrang char bab byung zhes dang chabs cig tu sde srid la'ang bstod bsngags zhus pa ni bka' drin che/ yag byung zer ba sogs yin/ de ni nga rang nang ma'i skyid sdug de'i nang la bsdad myong bas skabs der dge rgan bgres gras tshos gong gsal gnas tshul de dag gsung rgyun 'dugayang khag gcig gi gsung rgyun la/ gzhi rkang tshangs dbyangs kyi yab la rig 'dzin bkra shis zhu yi yod kyang / gzhas kyi nang don la/bkra shis dang / ldum rwa zer ba de dag skabs der gsang rgya dril bsgrags byed po'i nang mi dpon shar bkra shis dang / sa gnas lha sa me tog ldum rar yin pas der go dgos zer ba'ang 'dug gang ltar tshad ldan lo rgyus ngo ma'i yig cha 〈rab gsal gser gyi snye ma 〉zhes pa'i nang don dang/ dmangs gzhas nang ma de gnyis rtse mthun pa ltar 'dug pas the tshom ma dgos pa ltar red/ der brten gsham du nang ma 66(bkra la shis pa 〉 dbyangs sbyor dang / gzhas tshig ngo sprod zhu rgyur/gu ——1com2)—— cu

rdar44ge'i5'ab /nyikhyad chos ltar yin kyang / 'di'i thad lo ngo brgyad brgya yas mas nas bod kyi dmangs gzhas la sgra brtsegs gtong srol yod nges pa yin/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i 〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉las rang sgra rkyang pa drangs pa la/ /gzhan sgra rkyang par sbyar ba dang / / rang nyid yongs su drangs pa la/ /rang nyid yongs su sbyar ba dang / / rang nyid brtsegs pa de nyid las/ /brtsegs pa'i don gzhan sbyar bar bya/ /zhes sogs bod kyi dmangs gzhas sgra brtsegs sngar nas dar khyab yod pa gsal bshad thub pa red/de ltar yin stabs/ skyebo 'ga' zhig gis nang ma'i gzhas nye rabs nang dar ba yin pas de ltar min na gna' bo'i bod gzhas la sgra brtsegs gtong srol med tshul brjod kyi yod rung / de'i thad la rol mo'i bstan bcos kyi gzhung lugs dang / dngos yod kyi nang ma'i gzhas de gnyis kyi bar la kha brtsangs zin pas phyis nang ma'i gzhas la mu mthud zhib 'jug gis dmangs gzhas sgra brtsegs gtong srol de dag rang res rgyun 'khyongs dang gong 'phel gtong dgos pa yin/ / / /—158 sgo

naisgo'i446༄ste/riṣ+ṭhamo 46gle 4 tshogiyigadagye༅/ / stod gzhas dang nang ma'i gzhas kyi 'byung ba mdo tsam brjod pa/ /6 glu gar gyi rgya mtsho mi zhes skyebo'i tshogs kyis ring nas bsngags pa'i yul 'dir mi rigs rang nyid kyi thun mong nyams 'gyur dang sgyu rtsal khyad chos kyis phyug pa'i gzhas dang / zhabs bro mtha' yas pa zhig yod pa yin/ mi rigs gang 'dra zhig yin rung de'i rig gnas 'tsho ba 'phel rgyas song ba'i lo rgyus la bsams na glu gar ni dar sngaba'i gras dang / rig rtsal 'tsho ba'i rmang gzhir gyur pa zhig kyang yin snyam/ bod kyi mi rigs 'di thog mar saspre'u las byung tshul bshad par ngas khas mi len pa ma yin kyang gal te lo ngo stong phrag gnyis gsum gyi nang tshun la sga spre'u mi la 'gyur ba zer ba'i tshan rig dang mi mthun pa'i brjod tshul de rigs khas mi len pa'i skyebo rnams la ltos na bod kyi dmangs khrod glu gzhas la lo ngo stong phrag 'ga'i lo rgyus yod pa rang shugs su 'dod pa smos ci dgos/ bgrang bya chig stong sum brgya tsam gyi gong rol du byung ba'i da lta bed spyodagatong mus kyi bod yig 'di nyid dar ba nas bzung —159—

sa r+share/5)dab/lhad44 kyi ridab tshul〉4054/ phu༄༄di0 7nyabod kyi gna' bo'i snyan rtsom tshig bcad ji snyed pa dang dmangs khrod kyi gzhas tshig mang nyung la ma ltos pa zhig gna' bo'i yig mkhan dag gis bris pa'i lo rgyus deb ther dang / rnam thar/ sngon byung gtam rgyud sogs las mthong thub pa zhig yin/ dpe mtshon tsam brjod na/ stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi dus zing po rje khri sangs gsum gyi blon po myang rtsis sku dang dbas dbya'i tshab kyis zing po rje'i dbang gshed rtsub spyod la blo yid ma rangs par myang dbas mnon gsum kha 'cham ste stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi drung du mgo 'dogs par phyin nas dbu snyung bro mna' gcod pa'i tshe 'bangs kyis rig ste 6 mi bzang ni rta bzang zhig nyin zhing ni phag tshal na/ mtshan zhing ni 'phying bar mchis/ dgra 'am ni zhing /(zun )ci'u mi (tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha las drangs )zhes glu ru blangs nas 6 mi gzugs bzang rta shed bzang / nyin mo nags tshal gi phag na yib/ mtshan mo pho brang 'phying bar 'gro/ de dgra yin nam gnyen yin ci mi shes mi zhes smras pa lta bu dang khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs bskrun zin pa'i dga' ston skabs btsan po blon 'bangs dang bcas pas glu re blangs pa'i nang btsan pos dga' glu bcu gsum mgur du bzhes pa dang 6 shar pos stag ri dgu brtsegs blangs pa ’ dang 6 shar mos grong zer ring mo blangs pa mi sogs lo rgyus kyi yig char gsal ba dang / khri srong lde'u ba ——16(1——

———— rigasel ma sto murdabyung444kyi rid gaṣ+ṭhamo 0re'i 4chodi/bubatsan skabs kyi gzhas tshig 'ga' zhig dus phyis kyang 'ebyengs rgyas rdzong khongs dmangs khrod bro gzhas kyi nang la gtong srol yod pa sogs las bod kyi dmangs khrod glu gzhas la yun ring po'i lo rgyus ldan lugs mtshon pa yin/ gzhan yang 6 zlos gar mi zhes pa yul 'di'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi ya gyal 'di la mtshon na ring mo nyid nas rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang ba zhig yod/ sngon byon mkhas pa dag gis brtsams pa'i zlos gar skor gyi gzhung lugs ji snyed pa zhig yod pa'i nang tshan da lta mthong rgyu yod pa'i gras nas cung khyab gdal du gnas pa sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉dang de'i 'grel pa bcas yin/ bod kyi zlos gar la mi rigs rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams 'gyur dang / sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ldan pa ma zad/ de'i thad rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang ba zhig kyang yod pa de ni don dngos ra sprod 'pher ba zhig yin no/ da lta bod kyi dmangs khrod glu gzhas kyi gras nang ma dang stod gzhas kyi 'byung khungs dang / de dag dbus gtsang sa khul du dar khyab ji ltar byung ba'i skor gtso bor byas pa'i rang gi ngos 'dzin mdor bsdus tsam zhig gleng bar 'dod/dbapo/ stobasngos kyi 'byung khungs dang de stes gtsang phyos su ji ltar dar phre skor/stod mnga' ris sa khul ni gna' bo'i dus nas glu gar sogs rig d+ku ——161—— sgo

༷//sto chirtan55dab/4344 ridabaX'i74044/ ༄༄༄sartsal bya ba cung dar khyab che ba'i sa zhig yin pa'i thog bod kyi btsan po'i gdung rgyud (mnga' ris chos rgyal )kyis khul der mnga' dbang bsgyur pa nas bzung dus skabs shig ring rig gnas spyi dang bye brag glu gar gyi rig rtsal byed sgo dar srol chen po byung bar grags/ phyis sde pa gtsang pa mi thog gnyis pa kurma phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi dus skabs la stod mnga' ris khul nas gar mkhan khyed gu don grub dang / dga' g.yu ni/ jo bzang ched 'bod kyis glu gar 'khrab gtong byed du bcug pa dang / mnga' ris khul gyi khyad chos dang bstun pa'i 66gar rol mi zhes pa srol 'go gtod du bcug de rjes rig rtsal glu gar sogs kyi thad la'ang do snang chen po gnang mkhan sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos stod khul nas rol mo mkhas pa gu ti dang / rol mor byang chub gu ti'i bu bkra shis dang / tshe brtan sogs skong 'gugs gnang ba ltar khong rnam pas rol mo'i sgra gdangs dang bstun pa'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur nyer gcig bya ba dang 'brel gar pa gzhon nu mang po gso skyong byas te gar dang / mdo mdar/ sur ṇa/tasbu ra sogs 'bud rdung dkrol ba'i rol mo gtong lugs mi 'dra ba mang po bslabs/ dusamatshungasabya sgo blobazang dbang phyug dang / khang 'og dngos grub can gyis yoge dang tshig gi phan pa bsgrubs te rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa 'brug lo ste spyi lo 1688lor glu gar gyi rtsa tshig rnams gtan la phab pa ma zad/ sgra snyan rgyud gsum pa'i rgyud thebs dang bcas —162

———— /wa po ma ga smonai'eji45 gzha gaṣ+ṭhamo ne 0mo'i 4 ra/zhupa yang ri mo'i lam du bkod/ gar dpon gu ti can gyis gar phrug mang po gso skyong dang 'brel gar dang mdo mdar/ sur ṇa tam+bu ra sogs rol mo gtong lugs sbyong brdar byas nas tsa gar pa nya zhes zlos gar tshogs pa chung chung zhig btsugs pa nas bzung de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mdzad sgor grags pa'i dus ston khag la gar 'khyab kyi byed sgo spel ba'i srol yang byung ba ma zad/ tshogs mchod ser steng gi dus wo skabs la bod zla gnyis pa'i nang lha zhol dang ra che sogs mang tshogs kyi khrod du 'khrab ston yang byed/ dus de nas dbus gtsang yul gru spyi dang lhag par lha sa'i yul mi'i khrod du stod mnga' ris sa khul gyi glu gzhas te bsdus ming la/ 〈stod gzhas 〉zhes pa dar khyab ha cang chen po byung 'dugaganyisapa/ 〈lha r+sā stodaganas〉zer stosapa'i rgyu sgonagang yinaskor/stod mnga' ris sa khul tshud pa'i bod ljongs sa gnas khag la ring mo nyid nas dar zhing khyab pa'i gzhas ོ dang / rta 'thung / ljags bskyangs/ rbad/ sgor gzhas/ skad ra/ ngal rtsol byed skabs gtong ba'i las gzhas sna tshogs/ mgur ma/ tshogs glu sogs yod pa ma zad/de la yang yul gru so so'i dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa'i 'gyur khug 'dra min brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig yod pa ltar/ lha sa'i dmangs khrod du yang de dang 'dra ba'i glu gar rnam grangs du ma ring mo nyid nas yod/—163—

nu sa ——'e'i ——ngesartan5)dab/4344 kyi ridabaX 874044/ ༄ dulha sar stod gzhas dar tshul la cha mtshon na gong du smos pa bzhin sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dus su gar dpon gu ti can nas brgyud de lha sa'i grong mi'i khrod du stod gzhas dar khyab byung / stod gzhas lha sar dar rjes dus yun gang tsam zhig gi ring la stod gzhas kyi thog ma'i sgra gdangs 'gyur khug gi rnam par bsgyur bcos che rigs ma byung na yang dus skabs nges can zhig la slebs rjes lag len ngo ma'i khrod du stod gzhas kyi thog ma'i gdangs 'gyur de la yul dus rjes 'brangs kyis dmangs khrod glu gar mkhas pa dag gis rim bzhin lha sa'i dmangs khrod glu gar gyi khyad chos dang bstun pa'i bsgyur bcos byas pa dang / lhag par dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus 'gor dmangs khrod rol mo mkhas pa dge rgan rnam rgyal (1894—1942)gyis bsgyur bcos dang gsar gtod mang po byas/ de yang gtso bo rta dbyangs kyi gdangs gshis dang / 'gyur rgyan la bsgyur bcos kyis sngar bas snyan 'jibs ldan pa dang / 'khrug cha dod po zhig tu bsgyur thub pa byung / sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉las smyo dbus pa rnams kyis ldengs shing rī 4 'gyur/ / gtsang pa 'tsher zhing gsal ba yin/ / gtser zhing mdud pa sna mnga' ris pa/ / khams pa rnams ni brjid cing gyong /mi zhes byung ba ltar — yul phyogs so so'i gzhas kyi dbyangs gshis mi 'dra ba dang / lhan cig ri skyes pa'i gre 'gyur 'dra min yod nges pa ni mthong chos su gyur ba de ltar 0 ——164—— zhu

shāwer454༄ste/gaṣ+ṭhamo 0༄'i ji tshogiyizhubazhin dar khyab byung / dus de shed du lha sar mu nang ma'i skyid sdug )zer ba'i dmangs khrod glu gar tshogs pa zhig byung ba ma zad/ dus rabs nyi shu pa'i lo rabs bzhi bcu'i nang la'ang glu gar tshogs pa de rgyun mthud du gnas yod/ 'on kyang nang ma'i gzhas dbus gtsang phyogs su dar ba'i thog ma'i dus skabs su gong rim dbang sgyur gral rim pas kho tsho rang nyid kyi longs su spyad bya'i sgyu rtsal rnam grangs kyi gras su brtsis shing / gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis stod khul nas 'gugs 'bod byas pa'i rol mkhan kho pa'i gzim chung 6 nang mar mi glu gar 'khrab gtong byed du bcug pa dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skabs tā la'i sku phreng drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtshos gam bcar 6 nang ma mi dag dang lhan cig ṭudabyar gyi dus su rdzong rgyab klu khang du spro seng glu gar gyi gzigs mor rol ba bcas 46gzim chung nang ma mi dang gam bcar nang ma'i mdun sar 'khrab gtong byed pa'i glu gar du gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis 6 nang ma ’ zhes pa'i tha snyadabyung ba dang / dmangs khrod du khyab gdal byung ba'i rjes su yang 6 nang ma zhes pa'i tha snyad ma nyams par gnas pa yin/ 'on kyang da dung gom stabs mdun du spos nas rtog dpyod byed dgos pa'i gnas tshul zhig yod pa ni glang dar ma 'u dum btsan bkrongs rjes gnam lde 'od srung dang / yum brtan gnyis srid kyi dbang char ma 'cham par phan tshun dbar drag po g.yul gyi sbyor ba bshams te gnam lde 'od srung pham nas d+ku ——171——

kwa'es zinasan rir+shak+ta'i trī/ 4545sngarag64ba yang 4 tshodozhunang ma'i gzhas khag gcig gsar du brtsams pa ma zad/nang ma'i zhabs bro 'ga' zhig gi rol dbyangs nang pe cing khrang zhi'i rol dbyangs bar 'jug bed spyod byas yod pa ni/lta bu yin pa'i thog da dung zhabs bro'i skabs lus kyi stangs nga nga yi ge 4 /sgo 0 4 7 0stabs 'ga' zhig thad rgya rigs kyi gna' bo'i gus lugs mtshon pa'i 'gul stangs dang / bod rigs rang nyid kyi gshis lugs dang bstun pa'i sgeg nyams thog gus lugs phyag 'bul gyi rnam pa mngon par gsal ba'i stangs stabs zhabs bro'i rnam 'gyur dang sbyar ba sogs nang ma'i gzhas kyi grub cha mang po'i thad dang rol mo sogs gang ci'i thad la gzengs su thon pa'i legs skyes phul yod/ rnam mang phun sum tshogs pa'i bod kyi dmangs khrod gtam rgyud dang /sgrung gtam glu gzhas sogs dmangs khrod rtsom rig de tshos dus skabs so so'i lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul dang / spyi tshogs kyi snang tshul/ gal che'i chab srid kyi don rkyen/ lo rgyus thog gi mi sna'i gnas tshul/ bsam pa'i 'du shes dang / yul srol goms gshis/ spun zla'i mi rigs dbar gyi mdza' gcus kyi 'brel ba sogs tshad gzhi 'dra min gyi sgo nas mtshon par byas yod pas/ 'dir dpe mtshon tsam zhig drangs nas nang ma rgya ja lags zer ba'i gzhas —79—

snan5)dab/4344/ ridab/jing444//yogu༄༄༄0 1tretshig tu rgya ja nag po'i rtsig pa/ / shar phyogs ri las mtho ba/ / g.ya' rngan bu mo'i blo rgyu/ / sngon mo'i chu las ring ba mi zhes pa de las rgya rigs dang bod rigs mi dmangs dbar ring mo nas dngos thog brje res kyi 'brel ba'ang dam po yod pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog sung rgyal rabs kyi dus su/ja rta nyo tshong dar rgyas chen po byung ba'i gnas tshul mtshon gyi yod/gzhan yang nang ma 〈nang la byung ze 〉zhes par ya ge'i bde ba can de/ /skyid po rang dang tsheyod/ /tshad ldan bla ma rnams kyis/ /phyi ltas bslogs nas phebs kyis/ /ma gi'i dmyal khams bco brgyad/ /sdug po rang dang e yod/ / dbang chen dpon po rnams kyis/ / 'tshang kha bskyon nas phebs kyis ’ zhes pa'i gzhas tshig 'di la mtshon na don du chos lugs la zab rdzu 'ga' shas kyis gzhan la las 'bras kyi rnam gzhag dang /dge sdig blangs dor ston pa'i chos bshad rdzogs mtha' med pa zhig bshad kyi yod kyang / mthon po'i go sar 'gyings shing / khrims lugs btsan po'i bdag por rlom pa'i dbang chen dpon po rnams kyis lag len la rgyab kyis phyogs nas sdig nyes gsog pa'i bya ba kho nar gzhol ba yin zhes dbang bsgyur gral rim la rnag thog gtsag 'khel gyis zur za byas yod/ skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi cha rkyen 'og gzhas tshig 'di 'dra brtsams thub pa ni stabs bde zhig ga la yin/ de bzhin rgyal nang spun zla'i mi rigs dbar gyi mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba dang / rim byung krung su ——180——

——gug gogaring shā ——pa —— sa8 3 4545)zha ga64ba tsho 4snyem25 ra ludabyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas bar gyi 'brel bsta/ ) bod rigs mi dmangs kyis mes rgyal la dga' zhen dang / phyi rgyal btsan 'dzul par 'gog rgol byed pa sogs kyi snying don gyis mtshon pa'i brjod don phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhas ji snyed cig yod/ de'i phyir kho bo'i bsam par stod gzhas dang / nang ma'i gzhas gyi nyams 'gyur dang / sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos tsam du ma zad/ gzhas tshig gi nang don thad la'ang zhib 'jug gi rin thang ldan par ngos 'dzin byed kyi yod/ rig rtsal las don gyi thad nas bshad na nga tsho'i mdun du lhag pa'i gnad don ni mi rabs du ma'i ring la brgyud pa'i bod kyi dmangs khrod glu gar de dang de dag ci 'dra byas nas myur skyob byed dgos pa de yin/ tang gi bla na med pa'i gzigs skyong 'og da phan mi rigs rang nyid kyi rig rtsal ched las mi sna 'bor chen gso skyong byas yod pa de tshos bod kyi rig rtsal bya gzhag gong 'phel gtong ba'i thad la 'bad brtson cher bskyed kyis grub 'bras legs po 'jog thub pa byung yod/ nga tshos spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon dar spel gtong rgyu gtso gnad du bzung ste mi rigs kyi nyams 'gyur bzang po ma brlags par rig rtsal gsar rtsom gong mthor spel dgos pa los yin/ 'on kyang las ka dngos kyi nang bod kyi dmangs khrod glu gzhas byung zhing 'phel ba'i lo rgyus dang / nyams 'gyur/ sgyu rtsal khyad chos bcas kyi thad la sngar nas yod pa'i zlos gar skor gyi rigs —181—

༷/nga mu ——rak+ṣaphen5)dab/4344 ridab tshu〉4454/ ri ༄do0pa'i gzhung lugs sogs la zhib 'jug bya rgyu shin cazhan pa dang / 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang zab 'jug bya rgyu yang ma ldeng bas gsar rtsom gyi glu gar mi nyung ba zhig la mi rigs rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams 'gyur dang / sgyu rtsal khyad chos kyi bro ba de tsam med pa dang / yul gru so so'i khyad chos dang / glu gar gyi rnam grangs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs ma 'dres gsal bar mtshon pa ma yin par glu gar la la rta mgo lug mjug lta bu dang / rnam thar gtong skabs 'gyur khug ci yin 'di yin med par mnyam du 'dres pa lta bu sogs la lo rgyus dang / rigs lam/ 'tsho ba dngos bcas kyi gzhi bzung sa med pa'i snang tshul ya ma zung mi nyung ba zhig thon gyi yod/ des na stod gzhas dang / nang ma'i gzhas kyis mtshon dmangs khrod glu gar myur skyob dang / sngon gyi mkhas pa dag gis brtsams pa'i bod kyi zlos gar skor gyi rigs lam la zhib 'jug brtag dpyad bya rgyu ni dgos gal ha cang che zhing de yang 6 myur skyob mi kyi las ka legs 'grub thub min gyi 'gag rtsa ni 'go khrid kyis mthong chen byed rgyur thug yod la rig rtsal ched las tsho'i 'bad brtson la'ang rag lus pas bod kyi rig rtsal bya gzhag dar rgyas phun sum tshogs po yong ched/ dang thog tsa myur skyob mi kyi bya ba legs 'grub kyi don du/ rang cag thun mong gis 'bad pa lhur len bya rgyu ni gal 'gangs shin tu che ba mthong lags/ / / /— —182—

nairmekho454༄nyesari༅bral 4 4 tshogiyi0da༅༅/ / glu gar gyi rgya mtsho/ /6 glu gar gyi rgya mtsho mi zhes skyebo'i tshogs kyis ring nas bsngags pa'i yul 'dir mi rigs rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams 'gyur dang / sgyu rtsal khyad chos kyis phyug pa'i gzhas dang / zhabs bro rdzogs mtha' med pa zhig yod/ mi rigs gang zhig yin rung / de'i rig gnas kyi 'tsho ba 'phel rgyas byung ba'i lo rgyus la bsam na glu gar ni dar gshos dang / rig rtsal 'tsho ba'i rmang gzhir gyur pa zhig kyang red snyam/bgrang bya chig stong sum brgya tsam gyi gong du byung zhing / da cha bed spyod gtong mus kyi bod yig 'di nyid dar ba nas bzung bod kyi gna' bo'i snyan rtsom tshig bcad ji snyed pa dang / dmangs khrod kyi gzhas tshig mang nyung la ma bltos pa zhig gna' bo'i yig mkhan dag gis bris pa'i lo rgyus deb ther dang / rnam thar/ sngon byung gtam rgyud sogs las mthong thub/ dpe mtshon tsam brjod na/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su bsam yas gtsug lag khang bzhengs zin pa'i dga' ston skabs btsan po blon 'bangs dang bcas pas glu re blangs pa ste khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mgur ——183—— wi

tshog ci raṃ 0༅〉༄5dgra nar+shaX snyeglu blangs par ru nga yi dbu rtse rigs gsum 'di bzhengs pa ni 'dra/ zeg 3 pa 'dra ste nga re dga' mi zhes sogs dga' glu bcu gsum bzhes pa dang de / bzhin 'bangs mi tshos glu blangs pa ni 66shar phos skas ri dgu brtsegs — ji blangs/ shar mos grong zer ring mo blangs mi zer ba sogs lo rgyus kyi yig char gsal ba dang khri srong lde'u btsan skabs kyi gzhas tshig 'ga' zhig dus phyis kyang 'phyongs rgyas rdzong khongs dmangs khrod bro gzhas kyi nang la gtong srol yod pa sogs las bod kyi dmangs khrod glu gzhas la lo rgyus ring po yod pa mtshon pa red/ gzhan yang 66slos gar mizhes pa yul 'di'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kyi gras 'di la mtshon na ring mo nyid nas gyu rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang ba zhig yod/ sngon byon mkhas pa dag / gis brtsams pa'i zlos gar skor gyi gzhung lugs ji snyed pa zhig yod pa'i nang tshan da lta mthong rgyu yod pa'i gras nas khyab gdal du gnas pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉de yin/ bod kyi zlos gar la mi rigs rang nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams 'gyur dang / sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ldan par ma zad/ de'i thad kyi tre rigs pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang ba zhig kyang yod pa ni don dngos thog chi nas ra sprod 'pher ba zhig yin no/ /cho da lta bod kyi dmangs khrod glu gzhas kyi gras stod gzhas dang / nang ma'i gzhas kyi 'byung khungs dang / de dag dbus gtsang sa khul du dar 0 ——1sno)pho/—— shu

———— goraX 'inai'eng444ki rgud ga64ba tsho gachodi/zhukhyab ji ltar byung ba'i skor gtso bor byas pa'i rang gi ngos 'dzin mdor bsdus tsam zhig gleng bar 'dod/dang po/ stodagos kyi 'byung khugo dang / de stes gtsang khul du ji ltar dar r+ya skor/stod mnga' ris sa khul ni gna' bo'i dus nas glu gar sogs rig rtsal bya ba cung dar rgyas che ba'i sa zhig yin pa'i thog bod kyi btsan po'i gdung rgyud (mnga' ris chos rgyal )kyis khul der mnga' dbang bsgyur pa nas bzung dus skabs shig ring rig gnas spyi dang / bye brag glu gar gyi rig rtsal byed sgo dar spel chen po byung bar grags/ phyis sde pa gtsang pa'i mi thog gnyis pa kurma phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi dus skabs la stod mnga' ris khul nas gar mkhan khyed gu don grub dang / dga' g.yu ni/ jo bzang sogs ched 'bod kyis glu gar 'khrab gtong byed du bcug cing / mnga' ris khul gyi khyad chos dang bstun pa'i 66gar rol mi zhes pa srol 'go gtod du bcug pa red/ de rjes rig rtsal glu gar sogs kyi thad la'ang do snang chen po gnang mkhan sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos stod khul nas rol mo mkhas pa gu ti dang / rol mor byang chub pa gu ti'i bu bkra shis dang / tshe brtan sogs skong 'gugs gnang ba ltar khong rnam pas rol mo'i sgra gdangs dang bstun pa'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur nyer gcig bya ba dang 'brel gar rol pa gzhon nu mang po gso skyong byas te gar dang /bhe ——185—— d+ngha

shā 40zhesidang namado mdar ma/ sur ṇa/ tam+bu ra (sgra snyan la zer )sogs 'bud rdung dkrol ba'i rol mo gtong lugs mi 'dra ba mang po bslabs/ dus mtshungs bya sgo blobazang dbang phyug dang / khang 'og dngos 'grub can gyis yi ge dang tshig gi phan pa bsgrubs te rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i sa 'brug lo ste spyi lo 1688lor glu gar gyi rtsa tshig rnams gtan la phab par ma zad/ sgra snyan gyi rgyud thebs dang bcas pa yang ri mo'i lam du bkod/gar dpon gu ti can gyis gar phrug mang po gso skyong dang 'brel gar dang / mdo mdar ma/ sur ṇa/ taspu ra sogs rol mo gtong lugs sbyong brdar byas nas 6 gar pa mizhes pa zlos gar tshogs pa chung chung zhig btsags pa nas bzang de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mdzad sgor niring riring grags pa'i dus ston khag la gar 'khrab kyi byed sgo spel ba'i srol yang byung ba ma zad/ tshogs mchod ser sbreng skabs la mang tshogs kyi khrod du'ang 'khrab ston byed pa yin/ dus de nas dbus gtsang yul gru spyi dang /lhag par lha sa'i yul mi'i khrod du stod mnga' ris khul gyi glu gzhas te/bsdus ming la tsa stod gzhas mi zhes pa de dar khyab ha cang chen po byung yod/gnyis pa/ lha sa'i stodagazhes zer dgosapa'i rgyu mtshanagang yin skor/stod mnga' ris sa khul tshud pa'i bod ljongs sa gnas khag la ring mo nyid nas dar zhing khyab pa'i gzhas chen dang / rta 'thung / 'jags rgyangs (ljags bskyangs )rbad/ sgor gzhas/ skad ra/ ngal rtsol byed —186

———— /wa po ma ga mir+shadeng44434da gaṣ+ṭhamo na rwa ji ra/zhuskabs gtong ba'i las gzhas sna tshogs/ mgur ma/ tshogs glu sogs yod pa ma zad/ de la'ang yul gru so so'i dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa'i 'gyur khug 'dra min brjod kyis mi lang ba zhig yod pa ltar/ lha sa'i dmangs khrod du'ang de dang 'dra ba'i glu gar rnam grangs du ma ring mo nyid nas yod/ lha sar stod gzhas dar tshul la cha mtshon na gong du smos pa bzhin sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dus su gar dpon gu ti can nas brgyud de lha sa'i grong mi'i khrod du stod gzhas dar khyab byung zhing / stod gzhas lha sar dar rjes dus yun gang 'tsham zhig gi ring la stod gzhas kyi thog ma'i sgra gdangs kyi 'gyur khug gi rnam par bsgyur bcos che rigs ma byung na'ang dus skabs nges can zhig la slebs rjes lag len ngo ma'i khrod du stod gzhas kyi thog ma'i gdangs 'gyur de la yul dus rjes 'brangs kyis dmangs khrod glu gar gyi khyad chos dang mthun pa'i bsgyur bcos byas pa dang / lhag par dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus 'gor dmangs khrod rol mo mkhas pa dge rgan rnam rgyal (1894lo nas 1942lo'i bar )gyis bsgyur bcos dang gsar gtod mang po byas yod pa red/ de yang gtso bo rta dbyangs kyi gdangs gshis dang / 'gyur rgyan la bsgyur bcos kyis sngar las snyan 'jebs ldan pa dang / 'khrug cha dod pa zhig ṭu bsgyur thub pa byung yod/ sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉las 66dbus pa rnams kyis ldengs shing —187—

ra 40zhesidang na'agyur/ / gtsang pa 'tsher zhing gsal ba yin/ / gtser zhing mdud pa mnga' ris pa/ /khams pa rnams ni brjid cing gyong / /mi zhes byung ba ltar yul phyogs so so'i gzhas kyi dbyangs gshis mi 'dra ba dang / lhan skyes kyi gre 'gyar 'dra min yod nges pa ni mthong chos sa gyar pa de ltar ri ri ri ri ri ri na'ang / bsgyur bcos de dag rig lam dang ha cang mthun pa yin pas lha sar dar ba'i stod gzhas kyi thog ma'i sgra gdangs 'gyur khug 6 gtser zhing mdud pa mi de rim bzhin 6 ldengs shing 'gyur ba mi zhig la 'gyur ldog byung / stod gzhas mang tshebar dal gzhas re dang / mgyogs gzhas re gtong ba dang sbrags zhabs bro re rgyag dgos/ stod gzhas lha sar dar nas dus tshod gang tsam song rjes de snga dal gzhas zer ba la tsa rgyangs gzhas mi dang / zhabs bro dang sgrags mgyogs gzhas gtong ba der 6 'khrug gzhas mi zer ba'i ming btags/ 'khrug gzhas zer ba ni mgyogs po'i thog la 'khrug po'i don yin pas/ mgyogs gzhas dang bstun pa'i rkang stabs 'khrug po rgyag dgos pa de red/ de ni stod gzhas de lha sa'i dmangs khrod glu gzhas kyi gdangs dang 'gyur khug 'dres pa'i gzhas shig la 'gyur ldog byung ba'i mtshon rtags yin la/ rgyu mtshan de 'dra'i dbang gis 6 lha sa'i stod gzhas mi zhes zer ba yin/〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉su gsal ba'i 66gtser zhing mdud pa mi dang / 6 ldengs shing 'gyur ba mi gnyis kyi dbyangs gshis dang / 'gyur swā ——188—— d+ngha

rgyan gyi khyad par de dag la sbyar nas dpyad na/ stod gzhas kyi gras su gtogs pa'i lha sa'i dmangs khrod glu gzhas 〈jo lags sras chung 〉zer ba de deng dus stod mnga' ris khul du yang gtong gi yod pas gtong lugs :she/spyo — 2 3 r+ṣa jo la por /nga ga dang rgya ba 0 lob 5 — — —rnazhes pa ltar yin zhing / de yang gtser zer ba ni skad gshis nas mtshon gyi yod/ de ni rang byung khor yug sa bab mtho ba dang / ba tshwa can gyi chu mang ba'i sa khul gyi mi phal tsheba'i skad rang thugs kyis gtser tsam yod pas de la gtser skad kyang zer/ mnga' ris sa khul gyi sa mtho sar mi phal che ba'i skad gshis de 'dra yin 'dug tsa mdud pa mi zer ba de rta dbyangs nas mtshon gyi yod pa ni tshig khyim phal che bar 'gros stabs rer dbyangs rim re re tsam las med pa de'ang rten sgra'i ldengs 'gyur med par rta ring 'then pa'i thog skud par mdud pa tog tsam tog tsam brgyab pa lta bu zhig tu yod/ gdangs kyi 'khyer bzo'i thog nas bshad na stod rwa ——1sno)sbyo/—— d+ngha

gzhas ni sgor gzhas dang 'dra po yod par dpyad tshe de ni sgor gzhas yar rgyas su song ba las byung ba'i 'bras bu zhig yin par bsams/stod gzhas lha sa'i khul du dar rjes rim bzhin bsgyur bcos byung yod pas/ gong zhus 〈jo lags sras chung 〉lta bur cha mtshon na lha sar gzhas gdangs ldengs shing 'gyur ba'i tshul ni/lha — 26 0 / / 0 313 2 3 bru lha/(da1 /lo r+sha r+sha nga r+sha r+sha dza r+sha / snge rdo /zhes pa ltar de ni tshig khyim dang po'i 'dren tshul 'gros brdab dang po dang gnyis pa'i bar dbyangs snyoms pa de la ldengs zer ba dang / tshig khyim gnyis pa'i 'gros stabs dang po dang gsum pa sogs la gre 'gyur zer/ 'on kyang de ni 'gyur khug gi khyon yongs kyi rnam par bltos nas bshad pa zhig yin/ sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur la mtshon na yang de ni yar rgyas nges can zhig byung ba zhig yin pas rol dbyangs kyi 'gyur rgyan snyan 'jibs dod du song ba zhig yin/ sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i 〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉las/ zu 'dren pa dpag bsam ljon shing ste/ /bkug pa me tog 'khri shing 'dra/ / dbus zhan chu klung dal 'gro ba/ / 'gyur khug ——190— d+ngha

———ri la rigal rin //8 3 4445)༄da ga64ba 2 4 tshodisna0rgya mtsho zla bar bshad// ces gsungs pa ltar/du 'dren pa dpag bsam ljon shing ste mi zhes yul phyogs so so'i skad lugs 'dra min gyi thog nas/ glu 'dren pa'am/ glu len pa/ glu blangs pa gang zhig yin rung / thog mar 'go 'dzugs skabs phal che bar 12 — — — / zer ba dang yang na 6 — — — /sgo spru yang na gasgo༄dzo gsungs la zer ba de dag ni bod rigs kyi glu 'dren tshi spyi mtshungs shig yin pas dpag bsam gyi ljon shing ltar drang por 'dren pa de la zer/du bkug pa me tog 'khri shing 'dra mi zer ba de gong du bshad pa'i 'dren bzhin pa yin na'ang 'dra/ yang na ldengs bzhin pa yin na'ang 'dra/ de'i bar la 'gyur khug gtong ba de la zer/ dper na gzhas rdzo gcig gis dbyangs dang 'dres nas 'gyur 'gro ba'am/ yang na dbyangs rang nyid la brten nas 'gyur 'gro ba ste/ me tog thag 'khyud dang 'dra bar 'dren pa'i dbyangs de la brten nas de'i dbyangs dkyus yas mas gang zhig (tu'u )gcig la brten nas bkug pa de la zer/—191—

ra 40 ༄5dgra nadamangs khrod du tsamagrin khug mices bshad srol yod kyang / gong gsal sa ri paṇa gyis gsungs par gzhigs na 'dren pa'i nang nas bkug 'gro ba / zhig yin stabs 66'dren bkug zer ba de yin bsams/()6 dbus zhan chu klung dal 'gro ba ’ zer ba de ni dbyangs sgra zhan pa'am/ yang na bar du phyed rdzogs mtshams kyi dbyangs gshis lta bu yin pas/ dper na rnam thar gtong skabs bar du ram 'dregs len tshul de ni rta dbyangs mtho sar dbyangs kyi nga ro'i rtsa ba gsum ste 64ang mi 66'a mi lha ha migasum las lha a'i mi zhes mgrin pa btsum zhing dog par byas ri snye nas stod du thugs bskyed de 'don bskyed de 'don dgos/ 66'a'i mi zhes mgrin pa phye zhing glod de yangs par byas nas smad du thugs bskyed de 'don dgos/ gzhi rkang thog ma dang / bar ma/ dbyangs drag zhan tsam gyi khyad par ma gtogs dbyangs gshis kyi thad nas 'dren tshul khyad par 4 de tsam rang med/(kye66'gyur khug rgya mtsho'i zla bar bshad mi ces gsungs pa ni dbyangs dkyas (tu'u )gnyis sam phyed kyi thog la ring thang gang rung sna15— riring riring tsho 5 blangs pa de la zer (deng sang rlabs sgra zer )de ni rnam thar gtong skabs / ha cang gsal po yod pas 6 gre 'gyur ’ zer/ don du zla gzugs chu nang gsal ba 'dar bzhin yod pa ltar yin pas 2 'dar sgra mi yang zer de snga skyor lung lha mo'i nang la skad sbyong de byed srol yod pa ni dge rgan dan —192—

——— — la rin ////r+sha deng444gzhud ga༅bral tsho 4chod zhubag bag gro zer ba de red/ khong tsho shod srol tsa sog dbyug mi zer gyi 'dug pas/ kha gdang lkog ma 'dar bzhin gtong gi 'dug deng sang de 'dra med/ skabs der dge rgan des gtong skabs rngon pa'i 'bag gyon zhing mgo bor 'gul skyod med par 'bag gi og tshom 'dar bzhin gtong ba de ni bltas na mdzes la dbyangs kyi snyan 'jebs dod po zhig red/gong du zhus pa de dag sa paṇa gyis lo ngo brgyad brgya lhag tsam gyi gong nas gsungs pa yin pas rnam thar dang / nang ma/ stod gzhas tsam ma zad/ deng sang gtong mus yin pa'i rang re bod rigs sa khul khag gi dmangs gzhas la zhib 'jug byas par gzhigs na'ang mtshan nyid de dag mngon gsal dod po yod stabs yang dag pa yin pa dang ha cang 'jug po yod pa gsal bshad thub kyi 'dug gang lags she na/ skad sbyong byed stangs des mi rigs rang nyid kyi dbyangs gshis gzhir bzung nas glu dbyangs kyi khyad chos dang / bro ba thon po yong gi yod pa red/de bzhin stod gzhas kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i lha sa'i dmangs khrod glu gzhas phal che bar mnga' ris sa khul gyi gzhas gdangs dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos de 'dra yod pa ni bcos sgrig byas pa ltar yin kyang ma dbyangs (ma sgra'ang zer )dang / khyab khongs kyi dbyangs/ rjes 'bras kyi dbyangs/ gcod mtshams bcas kyi thad la khyad par de tsam che ba su 193—

ra 40༄5dang narang med/ de'i phyir stod gzhas lha sar dar rjes dmangs khrod glu gzhas mkhas pa dag gis bsgyur bcos rim par byas nas sngar bas snyan 'jebs yid dbang 'gugs pa'i glu gzhas shig tu 'gyur ba mtshon pa lags/gsumapa/ nang ma'i gzhasakyi 'byubakhungasadang tha snyadakyi go don/mi la las zu nagha ma mi zer ba de kusmir gyi kha che'i skad yin pas sgra zur chag nas 6 nang ma mi zhes zer ba yin zer/ yang la las kusmir gyi kha che'i skad nyams nas bod skad du de ltar zer bar ma zad/ nang ma'i gzhas ni a h+phu han nas bod du dar ba yin zhes kyang zer/ 'on kyang brjod tshul de rigs la lo rgyus dang / da yod gnas tshul la dpyad pa'i gzhi 'dzin sa khungs lung ldan pa ci yang med/ kha che'i skad smyonagha ma mi zer ba ni 6 gzhas zer ba'i don yin zhing / kho tshos gzhas yod tshad kyi spyi ming la 6 nagha ma mi zhes zer ba red/ 6 nagha ma dang zu nang ma mi zhes pa 'di gnyis sgra dang yig gzugs gang gi thad nas kyang khyad par chen po yod pa ni klog pa dang bltas pa tsam gyis shes thub/ 6 nang ma'i mi gzhas a h+phu han nas bod la dar ba zer ba'i gzhi bzung sa ni gong du bshad zin pa'i 6 nag ma mizhes pa bod skad du sgra zur chag nas smyo nang ma ’ zhes chen (spa chen :de/) shesarjes:re 6tsacad /gle :de ཿdzazin ba na ziṭa ba da ga /ji zug /sdu da pas 'a nga sa gong du dpyad pa zin pas bskyar gling mi dgos par ma zad/ a glu han —194

—— —— she // r+sha deng444༄༄da gaṣ+ṭhamo 4 4 ra 0dang / kusmir gyi rgyud/ la dwags khul bcas par tsa nang ma'i mi gzhas lta ci/ nang ma'i gzhas dang 'dra ba'i glu gzhas tsam yang rnyed du med/66nang ma'i gzhas mi dang / gar glu'i rta dbyangs mi 'dra na'ang dbyangs gshis dang / sgrig gzhi'i thad dang / rol gdangs kyi ma dbyangs/khyab khongs kyi dbyangs/ rjes 'brangs kyi dbyangs/ mjug sgril gyi dbyangs bcas ha cang 'dra po yod/ mi 'dra sa ni 6 gar mi la rol cha dang sbrags gar glu mnyam gzhas gtong ba dang / gar 'khrab pa'i skabs mdo mdar ma dang / sur ṇar bstun nas zhabs bro 'khrab pa dang sgrags gzhas tshig kyang rkang stabs dang bstun nas sems la nges pa byed pa las/gzhas gtong srol mi 'dug nang ma mi phal che bar kher gzhas sam/ yang na mnyam gzhas re btang phyin zhabs bro kher gtsang re yod pa de tsam zhig yin/ rta dbyangs 'then tshul gyi thad la 〈rol mo'i bstan bcos 〉las 8 tshig gi dus su tshig gsal zhing / dbyangs la dbyangs nyid gsal ba dgos/ / de gnyis 'dres tshe legs 'dre la/ / 'dres nas so sor gsal ba 'o/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar dbyangs kyi nga ro'i rtsa ba gsum ste/ tsa ha a 'a mi gsum dbyangs sgra drag zhan la gzhigs pa'i dbyangs sgra drag par tshig gsal gang thub dang / dbyangs sgra zhan par ha a 'a gsum rta ring thung la ltos par yang yang 'then pa de ni nang ma dang / gar glur gcig mtshungs yin pa tsam du ma zad/ gzhas wo rta ring rta thung dang /—195

0snga ci — nu r+sha ci ci ra 4༄〉sgro5dang naljags bskyangs sogs tshang mar thun mong du gnas pa'i khyad chos shig yin la/ 〈rol mo'i bstan chos 〉las bstan pa'i yul gangs can pa'i skyetso bo rnams kyi dbyangs dang / rol mo'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa mngon par gsal ba'i mtshan nyid de dag nang ma'i gzhas la yongs su tshang ba zhig kyang yin/ de'i phyir 66nang ma mi zer ba kusmir gyi skad zur chag pa dang / lhag par nang ma'i gzhas 'di a h+phu han las bod du dar zer ba de rigs ni khungs med kyi gtam 'chal 'ba' zhig tu grub pas/ rang rigs skyebo rnams la bltos nas bshad na/ nor bu lag tsayod dus nor bu'i nor nyams dpyod par ma 'phyugs pa zhig dgos pa ni gnad kyi dam pa yin/66nang ma'i gzhas mi ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus rnal ma'i rang bzhin ci 'dra yin dang / na nang ma mi zhes pa'i tha snyad ji ltar thogs sam zhe na/bod kyi btsan po'i gdung rgyud (mnga' ris chos rgyal )kyis mnga' ris khul du dbang sgyur ba'i dus de shed du khul de'i 'brog pa tsho gcig gi khrod du nang ma'i gzhas thog mar byung zhing / de rjes rim bzhin mnga' / ris sa khul phal mo cher dar khyab byung bar grags/ dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i dus 'gor gtsang pa sde srid mi thog gnyis pa kurma phun tshogs rnam rgyal dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mnga' ris khul nas snga rjes su rol mo ba dang / gar mkhan 'gugs 'bod gnang ba ltar stod ba ——18)(1—— sgo

baṃrmeng444༄༄cirinyal rngo'ihe5chodoyi0drung che rmar lam pa/ cing hu'u la shin tu mkhas / wadī/ga drung nor nang pa (da lta rgya gar la yod )sgra snyan la shin tu mkhas pa bhayi wa li (hu'i rigs tshong pa ) dang rta mdo tshe brtan dbang phyug ('di nga'i gcen po yin )nang mi gcen gcung tsho yang sgra snyan dang gzhas la shin tu mkhas pa gzhas ma a cag ye tsha /hu'i rigs)stod gzhas dang zhabs bro la shin tu mkhas pa gzhas ma bsod nams skyid 'dzoms dang phur sgron bcas yin/ de rnams ni nang ma'i skyid sdug nang gi yongs grags kyi mkhas pa dang / dge rgan gzhon pa'i thob thang yod pa bcas khyon skabs der nang ma'i skyid sdug khongs mi dang slob phug tshogs grogs bsdoms pas drug cu skor yod pa de dag yong khungs bod rigs gtso bor byas pa'i sku drag dang / tshong rigs/ bzo pa/ mi ser byings/ rgya rigs/ rgya gar ba/ hu'i rigs bcas yin/ ngas dge rgan rnam rgyal gtso bor byas pa'i dge rgan de dag gi sa nas nang ma dang / stod gzhas/ zhabs bro/ sgra snyan/ yang ching / tha'e hu'u/ cing hu'u bcas slob sbyong byas te lo bzhi bsdad pa dang skabs der lha sa khul du rig rtsal skor gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs kyi shod srol gcig gyur lta bur 'dug 1942 lor dge rgan rnam rgyal lags 'das rjes gong gsal mi sna de dag 'ga' zhig lo na mtho bas 'das pa dang la la las 'gan gyi rkyen pas phyogs su thon pa bcas nang ma'i skyid sdug 'thor ba dang rang nyid kyang sa gzhung gi rtsis khang nas thon —209

2go ༄༄'i preng 47974dzes—te gtsang phyogs su bskyod dgos byung rjes sa gnas gar bskyod du rol mo khag mnyam 'khyer gyis rang g.yog dag kyang rig rtsal la dga' ba dang rol mo phran bu shes pa re gnyis rnam thar mkhas pa'i skad grags yod pa'ang yod/ 1951lor bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs kyi gros mthun la ming rtags bkod zin 'phral krung dbyang gi sku tshab krang cing wu'u rgya gar brgyud bod du phebs skabs ka sbug tus gzhung nas phyag phebs rgya gar ka sbug bar phebs bsur bcar nas lha sa bar phebs lam sne shan zhus pa dang / khong gi slob ston 'og 1951lo de rang du gsar brjer zhugs pa yin/ 1954lor tā la'i bla ma dang paṇa chen rin po che rnam gnyis rgyal nang du phebs skabs lta skor tshogs pa dang chabs cig u yon krang sku gzhon nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med mchog dang / bod dmag khul khang gi chab srid u yon than kon san rnam gnyis kyis 'dems sgrug gnang ba ltar zas zhib slob chung dang po dang / rgyal gces gzhon nu shes rig mthun tshogs skabs de'i spyi tshogs 'dzin grwa bcas nas mi grangs 32 thog bod dmag khul khang rig rtsal tshogs khong nas li h+phung dang hwa yung tshal gnyis bcas sgrig 'dzugs kyis rang nyid nas tshogs gtso byas te rgyal nang du lta skor slob sbyong dang 'brel zhing chen sa khul nyi shu rtsa gcig la gzigs 'bul thengs bdun cu skor byas/ lhag par brjed par dka' ba'i nyin mo zhig ste/ skabs der bod kyi lo su ——1)1()—— sgo

r+sharme'i444༄ltasarinyal 46) ri rayi0gsar gyi dus chen dang stabs 'khel bas hwa rin thang tshogs khang chen mor mtho kru'u zhi dang krung dbyang gi gtso 'dzin rnam par gzigs 'bul zhu rgyu byung ba'i go skabs thob pa de yin/ gzigs 'bul gyi le'u'i rnam grangs ni tang dang ma'o kru'u zhir bstod glu dang / nang ma/ stod gzhas/sgor gzhas bcas yin/ gzigs 'bul zin rjes gtso 'dzin rnam pas byams brtse'i ngang thugs 'khur chabazhes kyis nga tshor bstod bsngags gnang ba dang 'brel me tog ze'u 'bru gnang ba dang khyed tshos slob sbyong yag po byed pa dang de'i rmang gzhi'i thog bod kyi rig rtsal tshogs pa btsugs te mi rigs rig rtsal yar rgyas gtong dgos zhes skul lcag gnang ba bzhin rjes su gong gsal tshogs mi'i khongs nas gnas tshul gyis rkyen pas mi bzhi bod du phyir log bya dgos byung ba phud/ de byings mang che ba krung dbyang mi rigs glu gar tshogs pa'i nang rig rtsal slob sbyong dang / nyung shas zhig ni mi rigs slob gling du slob sbyong byed du bcug rjes su bod kyi glu gar tshogs pa dngos su btsugs skabs gong gsal khongs mi de dag rmang gzhi lta bur gyur pa ma zad/ mi khag gcig deng skabs mi rigs sgyu rtsal mkhas can gras su rkang 'dzin gyi nus pa thon mus su gnas/ de ni bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thob 'phral tang gis gso skyong gnang ba'i bod rigs sgyu rtsal pa dang po'i gras yin pa dang / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol btang nas lo ngo bzhi bcu'i ring la —211—

2ske༄༄'i preng 4྅775dzesaṅkami rigs rig rtsal slob gso 'phel rgyas gtong rim nang khong tshos byas rjes ngo mtshar can bzhag yod/1955lor kho bo bod la phyir log rjes gzhon nu shes rig mthun tshogs khongs nas rig rtsal dril bsgrags ru khag sgrig 'dzugs gnang ba ltar / de'i tud krang byas te lha sa'i nye 'khor gyi rdzong khag dang / 'dam gzhung gnam gru 'bab thang / lam bzo khag bcas kyi las bzo ba dang dmag mi bcas la phyogs gcig nas rig rtsal gzigs 'bul dang /phyogs gzhan zhig nas tang gi srid jus dril bsgrags byed par bskyod pa yin/1956lor rgyal yongs rol mo'i mthun tshogs kyi tshogs 'dur bod kyi rig rtsal sku tshab kyi tshogs gtso byas te pe cing la bskyod cing lo der gzi brjid ldan pa'i sgo nas krung go rol mo'i mthun tshogs kyi las 'dzin du bdams thon byung / tshogs 'du grol rjes rang nyid mi rigs zlos gar tshogs khongs su phan tshun slob sbyong byas te zla bzhi tsam bsdad pas de'i ring deng rabs kyi rol mo'i shes bya'i rmang gzhi phran bu shes rtogs byung ba des deng sang rol mo'i slob khrid thog phan thogs chen po byung / de rjes 1978nas bod ljongs slob chen sgyu rtsal tshan pa'i rol mo'i dge rgan byas pa dang / de gong slob grwar bod kyi rig rtsal skor gyi slob tshan med pas rang nyid kyis bod kyi de snga'i rig rtsal lo rgyus kyi shes su ——212——

bya dang / rgan rabs ngag rgyun/ dmangs gzhas/ rang nyid kyi rig rtsal shes rtogs kyi nyams myong bcas zung sbrel gyis slob tshan phyogs sgrig dang / rig rtsal skor rang rtsom snga rjes spel ba de dag la/ 1984lo nas 1990lo'i bar bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo nas rim pa dang po dang /gnyis pa/ gsum pa bcas kyi gzangs bstod lag 'khyer gnang ba dang / lhag par du rig rtsal slob gso'i 'thab phyogs thog slob tshan phyogs sgrig gi nang don thad la chab srid kha phyogs dam 'dzin byas te bod kyi rig rtsal skor nas lo rgyus yig cha dang / dmangs khrod du ngag thog nas khyab gdal yod pa'i dmangs gzhas rgyal gces kyi bsam pa dang /mi rigs kyi 'brel ba/ mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur gyi nang don mtshon pa'i dngos yod kyi lo rgyus dpang rtags de dag rgyu mtshan du byas te mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rtso rig dang / rig rtsal skor gyi rigs pa'i gzhung lugs de dag zung 'brel byas te slob tshan 'khrid pa yin/de yang bsam pa gtsang la mi rigs mthun sgril dang / rgyal gces kyi go rtogs rang thugs kyis 'phel thub pa byung stabs slob chen gyi 'go khrid dang dge slob tsho'i dga' bsu dang / bstod bsngags kyang thob byung /da lta rang nyid ni rgyal yongs rol mo'i mthun tshogs kyi las 'dzin dang /rgyal yongs grangs nyung mi rigs rol mthun gyi las 'dzin/ krung go bod rol mo'i mthun tshogs kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa bcas kyi 'gan 'khur mus su —213—

2ske༄༄'i preng 44975sgor+shaṅkayod/ da phan rang nyid kyis bod kyi rig rtsal skor la spel ba'i rtsom yig gsham gsal/1980lor 〈skad grags yod pa'i dmangs khrod rol cha mkhas can dge rgan rnam rgyal la dran gso zhu 〉 zhes pa 'di 〈bod kyi mang tshogs rig rtsal 〉dus deb gnyis par 'khod yod pa dang / 〈stod gzhas dang nang ma'i 'byung ba mdo tsam brjod pa〉zhes pa de 1984lo'i 〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug 〉dus deb thog 'khod yod pa (der slob grwa chen mo nas rim pa gnyis pa'i bya dga' thob )bod rang ljongs dbu brnyes nas lo ngo nyi shu 'khor bar rten 'brel zhu ched 〈bod kyi zlos gar gzhas ma gtam bdams bsgrigs 〉zhes par ched brjod bris te 1985 lor bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas dpe skrun nas byas yod/ 1984lor rgyal yongs grangs nyung mi rigs rol mo mthun tshogs kyi tshogs 'dur bskyod nas 〈glu gar gyi rgya mtsho 〉zhes pa de gtam bshad byas shing 1985lor pe cing mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi 〈shes bya'i zegs ma 〉zhes par bkod yod/ 1986lor 〈bod kyi dbyangs kyi rnam gzhag skor nas skad sbyong slob tshan 〉 phyogs bsgrigs byas pa/ der slob grwa nas rim pa gsum pa'i bya dga' yang gnang myong yod/ 1989 lor 〈bod 'dir gtam rgyud kyi zlos gar dar tshul dang rig rtsal skor gyi lo rgyus shes bya thog mar gleng ba 〉 zhes pa rtsom 'bri byas par bod ljongs slob grwa chen mo su ——214——

nas lo der rim pa dang po'i bya dga' gnang / gzhan yang 〈stod gzhas dang nang ma'i lo rgyus dang 'brel ba'i gzhas brgyad cu skor la 'grel bshad dang bcas slob tshan phyogs bsgrigs 〉zhes pa ni 'di lo slob grwa nas par skrun bya rgyu yin zhing / der rol cha khag bzhi dang gzhas gdangs gzhas tshig dang bcas pa yod/ de bzhin slob phrug gso skyong byas par 81lo dang 82lo/ 85lo/ 91lo bcas 'dzin grwa khag bzhi'i slob phrug rnams slob thon skabs bod kyi rig rtsal skor gyi shes byar grub 'bras legs po byung nas 'ga' shas slob nyar dang / de byings slob grwa khag gi rig rtsal dge rgan byas pa dang / lhag par dge rgan gzhon nu'i khongs la 'bral med slob khrid byas te re gnyis deng skabs bod kyi rig rtsal lo rgyus shes bya'i zhib 'jug thog mkhas par gyur yod pa de ltar lags/ / / /—215
