r+sha544/she430 〈〈sgom tun44shi0 wa wa wa wa wa wa /2 3 — 1po spro nga wa yo po2 4 4 ༄ 44 4 2 0 ⑫/ 44 4khong gis skabs der rang nyid la bden pa yod bzhin du dbang shugs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas bden par bden skyabs med pa'i rkun rgyab rdzun langs kyis rang la pham nyes byung ba'i khong khro gnon mi thub par gab tshig lta bu'i sgo nas gzhas tshig de brtsams pa zhig yin pa ni rab gsal ab tu ra ma//bum pa'i nang gi bum rdzas//zhes pa'i go don ni bum pa'i nang gi rdzas ni rtsa che'i rdzas sna phun sum tshogs dgos pa ji bzhin du khong rang nyid shes yon phun sum tshogs pa'i mi sna zhig yin pa dang / rdzas sna tshogs kyis phyug pa'i bum pa ni mchod gshom gyi mdun na bzhag pa ltar rgyun du khong rang nyid dbang shugs ldan pa'i dpon po tshang ma'i mdun du ma byung mthu med byed pa ni/sa skyabaṇ+ḍi tas rol mo'i bstan bcos nang rol mo'i cha la mkhas gyur na// tshogs kyi nang la rgyan ltar mdzes//zhes gsungs pa ltar tshang mas mthong dang cha 'jog byed bzhin pa de ltar yang khang pa'i skor la dbang grags ldan pa'i dpon po tshos —222

r+sha tshunab454pade'o/wā64ba kun gru yi0 gu bden skyabs gang yang byed ma thub stabs/ bod la khrims ni mi 'dug /thugs bsam bzhes rogs gnang dang / / zhes pa'i tshig 'di byung ba dang / de bzhin khang pa'i bdag dbang mi la shor rjes gar 'gro 'dir sdod med pa'i skabs der gong gsal lha sdod bkras lhun mi ser 'go pas —nor 'dzin skyid tshal gyi khang khongs nas g.yar stabs zhabs bro'i bar gtong gzhas tshig la/ de dus sbrang char sil ma/ /bab pa tsam gyis yag byung / / zhes pa ni dus thog gi char pa bab pa lta bu'i phan gsos shin tu chen po byung ba de la brten nas sems 'gul thebs bzhin par — khong la bka' drin rjes dran gyis thugs rje che zhes zhu ba mtshon pa yin/ 1—— skabs der ab tu ra ma lha sa'i nang ma'i skyid sdug gi 'go 'dzin dge — ri rgan yin stabs gzhas de nang ma'i skyid sdug nang la khyab gnas byung ba sna ri dang / nang ma'i skyid sdug gis res gza' spen pa nam yin dgong dro snye ciXr+sha bye rol mo gtong bzhin par bar skor la skyod kyi yod pas gzhas tshig gi nang dzo wa4 ri don bde srung mi snas thos 'phral srid gzhung la snyan zhus kyis kha chesogs pa kyi gyod gzhi lha sa gnyer tshang las khungs nas byed kyi yod pas de ga'i tsho r+sha —— ci khrims rar ab tur ma ched 'bod kyis bod la khrims med pa'i rgyu mtshan — snaX /cigang 'dri zhib byas par ab tu ra ma ni dran skyen la rig stobs kyi sgyu rtsal phul rdo r+sāX ri du phyin pa zhig yin stabs pho rtsal sna dgu'i ya rgyal shags kyis pha rol ṭ+wāṃganon thub pa'i kho lag yongs su tshang bas/ khong gis ngas bum pa'i ———223—— ga /ci

r+shari44〉('ab 〈〈 sgom tunatswa4shinang gi bum rdzas/ /spos la dri ma mi 'dug /ces btang ba las/ bod la khrims ni mi 'dug / zer ba ma yin/ lar nas khyed rnams dgongs pa bzhes dang / bum pa'i nang gi rdzas dang / spos gnyis mchod gshom gyi mdun sgrig byed pa ma gtogs/bum pa'i rdzas dang bod kyi khrims gnyis 'brel ba gang yang med pa tshang mas mkhyen tshod ma red dam/ zhes bshad par khrims dpon dag mgo bo yongs su 'khrul te nang ma'i skyid sdug gi khongs mi gzhan rnams ched 'bod kyi 'dri ba byas par kho pa tshos kyang ab tu ra mas ji ltar brjod pa ji bzhin bshad pas kho pa tsho bya thabs gang yang ma rnyed par rang sor 'jog dgos byung bas ab tu ra ma la rgyal kha thob pa red ces shod srol yod/de ltar bod kyi stod gzhas dang /nang ma'i gzhas gnyis ni lha sa'i dmangs khrod kyi nang la dar srol chen po byung yod pa ltar de gnyis 'phel rim nang bod kyi spyi tshogs so so'i gnas bab dang /mi sna 'dra min gyi lo rgyus chab srid dang 'brel ba'i nang don mang po skabs so sor gsar rtsom mang po byas yod pas de dbang la gzhigs na ched las tshos zhib 'jug dang / rgyud 'dzin/ dar 'phel gtong dgos nges kyang / de tsam pa'i do snang mi byed pa de ni yag po rang ma yin snyam/ / / /su 224—

r+shawer444༄shesasngaṣ+ṭhamo 46gle 4 tshodiyi0da༅༅/ /lha mo'i gzhung brgyad kyi khungs bstan pa/ /ston pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar bdud rtsi'i gter/ /'khor ba'i 'ching rgya grol ba'i man ngag mchog /zlos gar lam nas skye/kun 'du byas te/ /dad pa'i rba rlabs 'phyo ba'i ched du brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ skabs don gleng bar bya ba ni gangs ljongs kyi rang nyid kyi yul goms gshis lugs dang mthun pa'i zlos gar 〈a lce lha mo 〉zhes 'khrab ston byed pa'i srol de dag grub chen thang stong rgyal po brtson 'grus bzang po nas dbu tshugs pa'i lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring po zhig 'ded rgyu yod cing yul phyogs sor sor yang lha mo'i tshogs pa dar khyab kyis de'i gzhung ni yongs grags mdzad brgya dpag bsam 'khri shing nas bton pa chos rgyal nor bzang dang / gzugs kyi nyi ma/ dri med kun ldan/gcung po don yod don grub/ 'gro ba bzang mo bcas bdag cag gi ston pa'i rnam thar 'gran zla bral ba lnga dang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum las bton brgyabaza'abal bza'i lo sa/ ༷༷ //ba 'a thang las bton pa pad ma

273nga /neri gasnol 4nyu0rkolasnyo'od 'bar gyi rnam thar dpag par dka' ba gcig rang yul dmangs khrod las byung ba snang sa 'od 'bum bya ba'i phul du byung ba'i gtam rgyud gcig bcas deng dus lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung brgyad ces grags pa de dag gi thog ma'i 'byung khungs la dpyad par bya'o/de yang 'khrab gzhung de dag bod zhi ba'i bcings 'grol ma thob gong nas rang cag gi grong khyer lha sar dpe khrom nang du dpe cha nyo rgyu yod pa ma zad lo ltar zho ston skabs lha mo 'khrab skabs rtag tu bltas nas bag chags yun ring zhig bzhag yod/ rjes sor 'khrab gzhung brgyad kyi rnam thar de dag yul phyogs so so'i skyebo rnams kyis dpyad pa ma byas pa'i khungs med kyi mtshar gtam rgyun 'jags mang po zhig gleng gi yod pa dper na/ chos rgyal nor bzang 'di bzhin da lta chu shur rdzong khongs su gtogs pa shel grong du byung ba yin zhes brjod/ de'i rjes shul mang po yod pa'i gnas bshad rgyag pa dang / de bzhin 'gro ba bzang mo'ang rta nag maṇ+ḍal sgang zhes gtsang rta nag gam/ yang na yul mon rta dbang rgyud du yin par ngos 'dzin te 'gro ba bzang mo'i 'khrab gzhung sogs lo rgyus kyi shul mang po zhig shod srol yod/ gcung po don yod don grub kyi lo rgyus chags yul yang rang re'i lha sa'i nye 'gram se ra dgon pa'i rgyab ri'i rgyud du yod lugs shod pa/ dri med kun ldan gyi lo rgyus nang bdud ri ha shang sogs kong po rtse la sgang rgyud du yod pa'i shod srol mang po dar yod —226—

rnasgo'i444༄nyesariṣ+ṭhamo 46gle ji tshogiyi0pa go rgyu yod/ nga rang gis lo mang po'i sngon du rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i dus tsam la thon pa'i dpag bsam 'khri shing lhug tshig tu bkral ba zhig mig shar dad rjes su 'brangs te mjal myong yang lha mo'i gzhung dang 'brel ba byas te zhib 'jug byas pa zhig ma yin kyang re gnyis de dang 'dra shas 'dug snyam pa'i bag chags shig 'dug pha jo phas su mkhas pa 'gas lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung gi 'byung khungs kyi thad la dpyad pa btang ste mdzad brgya dpag bsam 'khri shing snar thang dpar ma skad gnyis shan sbyar dang / dpag bsam 'khri shing sde dge dpar ma skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs nas zur tsam byas te bcos bzo byas lugs de dag la rgyu mtshan dang bcas te rtsom yig spel gnang mdzad pa de dag la'ang rang nas kyang yid 'thad pa lta bu byas/ lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung skor la gzhi 'dzin pa de rang byed kyi yod/ rmongs rtul dad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba dang /dbang rno chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba ltar brtag dpyad ma byas par yul phyogs kyi zhen khog byas te rig pa spyang zhing skab bde ba'i skyebo 'ga' zhig gis rang bzo byas pa de dag la rmongs rtul 'ga' zhig gis dpyad pa ma byas par ri bong bcal 'drog gis rjes su 'brangs nas lo rgyus 'khyog bshad lam ngan mu 'byams su gyur pa mang po zhig thos rgyu 'dug pas de lta bur ma song bar gzhung brgyad po'i khungs dang / bden pa dngos yod btsal te kun gyis dpyad gzhi gnang rgyu'i re ba yod/—227—

sa rdza 273slosno57 sang zhe474ca dang po/ chos kyi rgyal po nor bu bzang po'i khungs ni rgyal po dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa'i dpag bsam 'khri shing las byang chub sems pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa nor bzang gi yal 'dab ste drug cu rtsa bzhi pa de yin/ de yang de nyid las ji skad du yon tan sum tshogs pa'i gter rgyal po nor zhes bya ba byung / lag pa yi ni sa la 'khyud/ / dbyangs can dag ni mgrin par byas/ / ngag gi dpal ni rab tu bstar/ / grags pa kho na rab tu bskrad/ / de yi btsun mo mdzes ma la/ / bu ni nor bzang zhes bya ba/ /gter brgya dang ni grags pa dang / / lhan cig skyes pa byung ba gyur/ / zhes sogs zhu yig byung ba ltar khungs ni 'di yin par the tshom bya dgos pa med/ de las byung ba'i 'khrab gzhung zur phyung de yang rtsom pa po sding chen smyon pa tshe ring dbang 'dus shel skar las 'dzin skabs brtsams pa — yin pa gsal bar gzhigs na dus tshod ni rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i sku dus las snga ba ma yin/ rnam thar de'i nang du a mchod ha ri nag po zhes pa sogs mi'i ming dang bsu chang dang go gsol gtong ba sogs rang cag gi yul srol dang mthun par bcos pa ma zad tshig sbyor gyi 'gro lugs la bsgyur bcos mang po byas yod pa de ni bltas pa tsam gyi shes thub kyang gong bshad ltar rang cag gi yul ga shed du gnas bshad rgyag pa dang ngos 'dzin byed pa de dag rgyang thag ha cang ring po yin pa ma zad nor bzang gzhung rtsom pa po rang nyid nas kyang zu ——1)shā)co)—— d+ngha

rdarmecho454༄shesariṣ+ṭhamo 46gle ji tshodiyigasngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i snga rol du byung bar bzhed pa'o//gnyis pa/ gzugs kyi nyi ma'i rnam thar gyi khungs ni dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa'i dpag bsam 'khri shing las byang chub sems dpa'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i pad ma ldan gyi rtogs pa brjod pa yal 'dab ste drug cu rtsa brgyad pa de yin/ de yang de nyid la ji skad do gci ba 'thungs pas mngal gyi sgo thob pa ri dwags bu mo ni mdzes sdug bdud rtsi'i rgyun ldan zhing chu ni len du 'ong ba dag ces sogs byung ba ltar yin la de las zur du phyung ste rgyas bshad kyis brtsams yod pa ni gsal bar rtogs thub/ rnam thar de ni bcos sgrig byed po des kyang lo rgyus de rgya gar du byung yod tshul gsal po bris yod pas bod la 'pho 'gyur byas nas ming 'dogs rgyu de ni mi 'os par gzigs nas gong gsal dang 'dra ba'i sa cha gzhan du 'dra dpe rgyas 'gebs byas pa zhig go rgyu mi 'dug skyes rabs nang mdor bsdus tsam las med kyang rtsom pa pos rig bcos kyis 'bri skabs nges 'byung skyoshas skyem ba'i brjod don mang po zhig bris yod pa/gsum pa/ dri med kun ldan/ bzhi pa/ gcung po don yod don grub/lnga pa/ 'gro ba bzang mo bcas kyang ston pa sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar khag nas bton pa yin cing de tsho ni skyes rabs khrag gi nang don mang po zhig mnyam bsres kyis ming bsgyur nas bar lhus yod/ rtsom gzhi ni dpag bsam 'khri shing dang / skyes rabs so bzhi/ mdo mdzangs blun sbu ——rwaperwapesbyo/—— sgo

༷ rdo riXrmi rwa ni734 neri nasnol sprengan0 4( sogs sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs de rang yin/ 'khrungs rabs de tsho — ni pha rol du phyin pa'i mdzad pa re re la ched du dmigs te bris pa sha stag ——— yin cing dri med kun ldan ni dpag bsam 'khri shing gi yal 'dab bzhi pa rgyal po thams cad sgrol gyi rtogs pa brjod pa dang ha lam gcig 'dra ba ce yod/ 'on kyang 'khrab gzhung gi nang du rgyal po dri med kun ldan gyis cig — nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung dang / bu dang chung ma rang nyid kyi /ske lha ri ci spyan la sogs pa sbyin pa mdzad tshul gzhung gcig gi nang du bsgril te bris ༷ snye — ༷ dzā co yod kyang thams cad sgrol gyi nang du spyan sbyin par btang ba de gsal med rkoX —— ——— —4༷ na de ni skyes rabs le'u gzhan nas blangs te bcug pa zhig yin nges/༷ de yang ji skad du sbyin pa 'jig rten pha rol log pa'i nor/ /dbul ba'i ci ༷ g.yang sa chen po srung ba'i rten/ /'jigs rung jag kun mun pa rab tu lha / ci gsal/ /bzod dka'i sdug bsngal skyob pa'i longs spyod yin/ /zhes kyang ri ༷mi ༷ smras so/hūṃ/ 〉 〉 / de bzhin gcung po don yod don grub lta bu dpag bsam 'khri shing kau ci /sgyuX tram̐ bye bye gi klu 'dul bar byas pa'i yal 'dab drug pa ba ra da'i gling du bskyod diXdiX shegu ༷ pa'i yal 'dab nas tshig 'gros blangs te gsar rtsom lta bu byas shing de tshordo ༷ ༷༷ 〈〈〈 yang dpag bsam 'khri shing nang gi sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar zur phyung gis dza 'i—— — rgyas bshad byas te bcos yod pa gsal po yod/ dper na/ mtshan sdo/snye 4/ / 4 — tsam la brtag na'ang gcen po rgyal bu don kun grub pa zhes sangs rgyas rtso ci ——11(5()——

r+sharmeng444༄༄ciriṣ+ṭhamo 47 trī rayi0rang gi mtshan btags yod/ de bzhin klu yul nas yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel sogs pa mang po blangs te rang gi ma la phul ba sogs skyes rabs kyi nang du de lta bu'i 'byung ba ni mang po byung yod pa ra 'phrod thub bo/ 'gro ba bzang mo yang skyerabs kyi le'u zhig las bton te kha snon brgyab pa ste sras lcam sring gnyis lta bu shan pas ma bsad par tshe thar btang ba dang / nya pas ma bsad par tshe thar btang ba/ bdol pas ma bsad par tshe thar btang shā la sogs pa'i rim pa mang po zhig rgyas bshad byas pa de tsho dper na/ skyerabs le'u nang du lcam sring 'khrid de ma bsad par sbas nas bzhag ste rjes su bton pa sogs thengs gcig byas yod na 'dir yal 'dab rgyas te snyan po ring po rim pa gsum la rgyas bshad byas te nges 'byung skyethub pa zhig nubacos yod pa ma zad/ mdzad brgya rang nas bton pa ni lha mo ba'i gzhung bshad kyi nang du yang bdag cag gi ston pas slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su dag pa'i skyeb lnga brgya dang / ma dag pa'i skyeb lnga brgya bzhes pa'i 'khrungs rabs nas da lam mkha' 'gro'i bu mo 'gro ba bzang mo'i gzhung brjod par bya'o zhes brjod kyi yod/de yang dag pa'i skyeb lnga brgya ni rgyal po la sogs pa mi'i 'gro bar skyeb bzhes pa dang / ma dag pa'i skyeb lnga brgya ni ri bong la sogs pa'i dud 'gro'i 'gro bar skyeb bzhes pa'i tshul yin/ da dung rgya bza' bal bza' dang / pad ma 'od 'bar/ snang sa 'od 'bum bcas kyi gzhung gi skor —231—

27344 neri nga2444 4ngan0 4yang 'og tu 'chad par bya'o/sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar legs par bcos te ——'khrab gzhung du bgyis pa de tsho chos rgyal nor bzang gi rnam thar tsam la ma gtogs gzhan dag la rtsom pa po'i mtshan yang bkod med la dper na/gcung don yod don grub kyi rnam thar lta bur yang rtsom pa po'i mtshan med pas gzhung de yang gsang ba'i rnam thar yin zhes gsungs pa'ang skye rabs gzhung de 'dra zhig las bton pa yin zhes gsungs na rgyas spros kyi bcos bsgyur mang po zhig byas yod pas yid la dogs pa'i rang bzhin ri chen po yod mkhan tshor log lta skyeb 'gog pa'i ched du gsang ba mdzad ṣ+ṭṛ neX — — — — pa'ang gsal por mtshon thub/ 'ga' zhig gis gzhung de dag tshang ma ngh+ru bye/sna ca ཿcho dmangs khrod kyi sgrung phal pa zhig yin par ngos 'dzin byed pa dang / yang /sheX sna nga 'ga' zhig gis lung bstan la sogs par don gzhan zhig tu ngos 'dzin 1 〉 rdo bye cho gyi go ba len pa thams cad gzhung che ba rnams ma mthong ba'i skyon dang / ༷༷ sde ༷ hūṃ / 1ri na yang na rang 'dod ltar gyis deng skabs kyi dmangs sgrung phal pa zhig tu ༷ bye rdo ༷༷༷ ༷ rdo rdoru rgyug pa leb 'dur du gtong ba'i byed stangs de tshor rang cag rnams kyis / tsheX sna dhi ༷bye / phyin chad gzab nan ོ pos zhib 'jug byas te bag yod par 'jug ḍi sdum thiganyis dzñā dgos/ de bzhin a lce lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung brgyad kyi nang tshan drug pa rgya 4/ ༷ ༷༷ bza' bal bza' ni ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi nang nas bton pa zhig yin sna rdo sa / rtse cing / khyed rnam pa tshos ma ṇi bka' 'bum gzigs myong ngam/ ma ṇi bka' kāX ri 'bum gyi nang du spyan ras gzigs kyi mdzad pa mang po zhig gung sgrig yod —232—

rdastusta454༄ste/sbaṣ+ṭhamo 46gle ji tshogiyi0pa de'i nang du srong btsan sgam po'i lo rgyus dum bu gcig yod pa'i tshig 'gros la bltas na mdo mdzangs blun nang gi sangs rgyas kyi 'khrungs rabs nas drangs te bsnan pa 'dra ba rgya bza' slong mkhan rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po/ ge gsar dmag gi rgyal po/ stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po/ bha ta hor gyi rgyal po/ bod blon mgar la sogs pas rta ma brgya bu brgya/bya ma brgya bu brgya/ tsan dan shing gi mgo mjug dbye ba sogs dang /mdzes ma brgya yi nang nas lha gcig ngos 'dzin byed pa sogs bkod yod kyang bod kyi lo rgyus rnying pa dang rgya'i rgyal rabs la de dag gsal med/bdun pa/ pad ma 'od 'bar ni pad ma bka' thang las bton pa/bka' thang la'ang shel brag ma dang / zangs gling ma/ bka' thang sde lnga la sogs pa mi 'dra ba mang po yod cing /slob dpon pad ma'i rnam thar la rgyas bsdus mi 'dra ba mang po yod kyang rtsom pa pos bsgyur bcos kha snon gyis rgyas su btang bar the tshom med/ dper na/ 〈bka' gdams pha chos bu chos 〉kyi nang du yang rgyal po dad pa bstan pa srin yul du sman me tog ku sha na len par phebs pa'i lo rgyus shig yod pa de dang pad ma 'od 'bar gyis gser gyi slang ('khar rnga )len par phebs pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa de gnyis dngos po mi 'dra tsam las srin yul du phebs lugs phebs stangs sogs ni gcig 'dra ba ngo mtshar che/brgyad pa/ snang sa 'od 'bum ni bod rang du byung ba'i dmangs —233—

shā sgro 2734 55 4snol spregrel4 4—byerdo wa ri khrod du byung ba'i dmangs khrod kyi sgrung gtam snyan po zhig yin/ da lta /༷༷ yang rgyal rtse khul du yul gyi ming ljang phad khud nang pa zer ba dang / ri nang zer ba/ dgon pa se rag sgrub sde/ brtse chen zam pa sogs mthun ri cuX pa'i ming mang po yod pa de tsho ni 'os pa'i skad cha rang red/ yin na yang ༵ ༷ snang sa 'od 'bum 'das log gi gnas tshul dngos su byung yod med ni da ci lta/shāḥ0 lta nga tshos thag bcad nas bshad thub kyi ma red/ 'on kyang rgya sgrung gi 'i ༷snro ༷ca nang du 'das log mang po byung ba'i lo rgyus yod/ rtsom lugs de ni ha ṭ+wāṃ snye ci swā r+sha cang yag po red/ mi rnams la blangs dor ston pa'i me long 'dra ba ste che lnga 'o phyin chad kun gyis bya ba ngan pa'i phyogs la spang bya dang bya ba bzang po r+sharme nyams su len dgos pa'i gdams pa zab mo zhig yin la/ de ni dmangs 〉/ khrod kyi sgrung gtam gyi gras su bzhag kyang 'grigs shing sgrung gtam de tsho lha dze+e ༷ sdoX mo ba'i 'khrab gzhung lta bur dmigs te brtsams par mdzad pas rtsa ba guX lnge khyoX sngon byung ston pa'i rnam thar rjes 'jug slob mas nyams su blangs chog ༷ wa ༷ par ltad mo ba tshor sems 'gul thebs thub pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i gtam 4) ༵ —— bshad mang po 'bri gnang mdzad yod cing / gong du zhus pa ltar lo rgyus hūṃ hriX4 de tsho'i rtsom pa po mkhas dbang tshos rang gi mtshan yang ma bkod pa'i rgyu sdu sdi sdo ri mtshan yang de tsho min nam snyam/ yang na sgrung gtam rnam thar de tsho'i — nang nas snang sa'i sgrung gtam 'dir mtshon na khyim pa'i nang du yong srid — pa'i gson nyams ldan zhing yid dbang 'phrog pa'i bslab bya dang 'khrab — —234

skastusta444༄sngesagaṣ+ṭhamo 46gle ji tshogiyi0gzhung gzhan dag de tsho yang phyi rabs pa tshor bslab bya gtong ba'i gdams pa ngoms su chog pa'i phul byung dang 'gran zla bral ba'i rtsom sha stag yin kyang mkhas dbang rnam pa de tshos khengs skyungs kho na mdzad de rang gi mtshan yang ma bkod pa yin srid/ gang ltar ljags rtsoms de tshor gzhan la nges 'byung skyeba'i dgos pa khyad par can yod stabs bsngags brjod dang rjes su yi rangs tshad med zhu rgyu yin no/— rnam dkar 'di yis bden rdzun 'byed nus pa'i/rnam dpyod 'gran zla bral ba 'thob gyur te/rnam dag ya rabs gzur gnas blo gros kyis/rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob gyur cig /gong gsal gi lha mo'i 'khrab gzhung gi 'byung khungs de dag mkhas dbang mang che ba'i ngos 'dzin nam bzhed pa gcig mthun ltar yod pa dang lhag par du mkhas mchog dam pa hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar de nyid kyis 'khrab gzhung de dag rang gi ched du rgyal ba'i bka' bstan nas bstan 'gyur gyi gras su bzhugs pa dpag bsam 'khri shing lhug tshig tubakral ba zhig yod pa dang / de rjes sde dge dpar ma'i bstan 'gyur nang gi (ke ) (khekapod gnyis skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi dpag bsam 'khri shing bcas la zhib 'jug snga rjes gnang ste/ gong bshad ma dag rgyun 'byams kyi shod tshul de dag khungs med yin pa'i dpyad gzhi sbu ——235——

273zhu/55 47shes4nyu0boshisnyodang dag bcos gnang rgyur mkho nges kyi dmigs yul bcangs te thog rinamar rtsom pa po rgyal po dge ba'i dbang pos mdzad pa'i dpag bsam 'khri shing las 'khrab gzhung de dag zur 'don gnang 'dug pa ltar phran nas gong gsal de dag la dgos nges rnams snon 'phri phran bu tsam las rtsa ba'i gsung rgyun hor khang bsod nams dpal 'bar de nyid kyi zhib 'jug nan tan gnang 'dug pa ltar phran nas gcig gyur gyi ngos 'dzin nges rnyed thub pa ltar yin/ yin na yang / gong gsal 'khrab gzhung de dag gi nang don la/ gzhi rkang 'jig rten bya gzhag gi blangs dor ston pa'i bslab bya dang / ya rabs srol gtod mig dper 'os pa'i bya bzang mang po zhig yod/ chos lugs kyi lta ba'i thugs rkyen yang mang po yod/de ni skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab la gzhigs pas g.yol thabs med pa zhig yin/ da lta ni mar khe si ring lugs lta ba de las spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi lta ba yin stabs spyi tshogs 'pho 'gyur 'gro ba dang chabs cig mi'i bsam blor thugs rkyen chen po thebs te 'phel rgyas gong 'phel chen po byung ba ltar gong gsal 'khrab gzhung de dag gi nang don 'ga' zhig deng skabs kyi mi'i bsam blo'i dgos mkho dang mi 'tsham pa zhig chags 'go yi yod/ der brten gong gsal 'khrab gzhung de dag la mi rigs kyi bsam blo'i 'du shes la sgyu rtsal gyi thog nas dga' zhen chen po byed pa ltar/ rang res gong gsal 'khrab gzhung de dag nas snyigs su ——236

naistusta454༄ste/ri4la 46gle ji tshordoyizhudor bcud len byed skabs bya thabs mkhas po zhig byed dgos pa ste gtso bo mi rigs rang nyid kyi goms srol sgyu rtsal rgyun 'khyongs kyis mi rigs kyi khyad chos ma brlags pa dang gcig 'khrab gzhung rnying pa bcos sgrig byas te zur 'don mkhas po dgos pa ni gtso bzhugs mi sna so so'i rnam thar gtong srol rta ring thung 'bring gsum yod pas de'i nang nas snyan 'jebs dod pa'i ngag gi sgyu rtsal bdams dgos pa dang gnyis / mi rigs kyi sgra rig dang mthun pa'i 'khrab gzhung 'khrug cha dod la ltad mo ba tsho'i yid dbang 'phrog thub pa dang gsum/ 'khrab gzhung bcos sgrig byas te zur 'don byas pa'i 'khrab bya ni gar gyi cha byad dgu/ 'di ni zlos gar 'khrab mkhan gyis lus kyi rnam 'gyur dang / ngag gi zabarjod gnyis la brten nas 'khrab bya'i mi sna rigs mi 'dra ba so so'i bsam blo'i nang don dang nyams 'gyur dngos su mtshon par byed pa dang / de yang 1sgog pa/2dpa' ba/ 3mi sdug pa/ de gsum lus thog nas mngon dgos pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / 4rgod pa/ 5drag shul/ 6'jigs rung / de gsum zabarjod las mngon thub pa'i rnam 'gyur/ 7snying rje/ darngam pa/9zhi ba de gsum sems nas bsam pa phyi'i rnam 'gyur nas mtshon thub pa byed dgos pa bcas yin/de ltar nyams dgu po des bsam blo mtshon thub dang mi thub ni 'khrab ston byed mkhan gyi sgyu rtsal chu tshad mtho dman la rag lus pa yin pas gong gsal ji bzhin byung na ltad mo ba'i sems la shugs su ——237——
